  content: |
      package io.simpleide.dap;
      
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.ArrayList;
      import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Locale;
      import java.util.Map;
      import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
      import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
      
      import org.slf4j.Logger;
      import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
      
      /**
       * Starts Java debug sessions through the JDT language server.
       *
       * <p>
       * The Java debug adapter is not a standalone process: it is hosted by the JDT language
       * server and reached over TCP. The bridge asks the language server to start its debug
       * server with the {@code vscode.java.startDebugSession} command, resolves the main class
       * and class path with {@code vscode.java.resolveMainClass} and
       * {@code vscode.java.resolveClasspath}, and then connects a {@link DapSession} to the
       * returned port. This keeps Java debugging on the same language server that already
       * provides completion and diagnostics for the file.
       *
       * <p>
       * Covered by {@code JavaDebugBridgeTest}.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      public final class JavaDebugBridge {
      
        private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(JavaDebugBridge.class);
      
        /**
         * Command that starts the DAP server hosted by the language server and returns its
         * port.
         */
        public static final String START_DEBUG_SESSION = "vscode.java.startDebugSession";
      
        /**
         * Command that resolves the main classes of a source file.
         */
        public static final String RESOLVE_MAIN_CLASS = "vscode.java.resolveMainClass";
      
        /**
         * Command that resolves the module and class paths of a main class.
         */
        public static final String RESOLVE_CLASSPATH = "vscode.java.resolveClasspath";
      
        private static final long COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30;
      
        private JavaDebugBridge() {
        }
      
        /**
         * Minimal LSP command surface used by the bridge.
         *
         * <p>
         * {@link io.simpleide.lsp.client.LspClient} satisfies this contract through its
         * {@code executeCommand} method; tests provide a stub.
         *
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public interface JavaDebugClient {
      
          /**
           * Runs a workspace command on the language server.
           * @param command command identifier
           * @param arguments command arguments
           * @return a future completed with the command result
           * @author BrunoRNS
           * @since v1.1.0
           */
          CompletableFuture<Object> executeCommand(String command, List<Object> arguments);
      
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts a debug session for a Java source file.
         * @param client language-server command client
         * @param program Java source file to debug
         * @param breakpoints initial one-based line breakpoints
         * @param listener listener for execution state changes, may be {@code null}
         * @return the started session
         * @throws IOException when the language server cannot start the debug server or the
         * session cannot connect
         * @throws InterruptedException when the calling thread is interrupted
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static DapSession start(JavaDebugClient client, Path program, List<Integer> breakpoints,
            DapSession.Listener listener) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
          int port = startDebugSession(client);
          Map<String, Object> launchArguments = launchArguments(client, program);
          DapSession session = new DapSession(program, port, launchArguments, listener);
          session.start(breakpoints);
          return session;
        }
      
        /**
         * Asks the language server to start its debug server and returns the port.
         * @param client language-server command client
         * @return the TCP port of the debug server
         * @throws IOException when the command fails or returns no port
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static int startDebugSession(JavaDebugClient client) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
          Object result = invoke(client, START_DEBUG_SESSION, List.of());
          Integer port = asPort(result);
          if (port == null || port <= 0) {
            throw new IOException("The Java language server did not return a debug port.");
          }
          LOGGER.debug("JDT debug server is listening on port {}.", port);
          return port;
        }
      
        /**
         * Builds the DAP launch properties for a Java source file.
         * @param client language-server command client
         * @param program Java source file
         * @return the launch properties sent in the DAP {@code launch} request
         * @throws IOException when the main class or class path cannot be resolved
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static Map<String, Object> launchArguments(JavaDebugClient client, Path program)
            throws IOException, InterruptedException {
          Map<String, Object> arguments = new LinkedHashMap<>();
          arguments.put("type", "java");
          arguments.put("request", "launch");
          arguments.put("name", program.getFileName().toString());
          arguments.put("console", "internalConsole");
          arguments.put("noDebug", Boolean.FALSE);
          Path parent = program.getParent();
          if (parent != null) {
            arguments.put("cwd", parent.toString());
          }
      
          List<Map<String, Object>> mainClasses = resolveMainClasses(client, program);
          Map<String, Object> selected = selectMainClass(mainClasses, program.getFileName().toString());
          String mainClass = selected == null ? null : asString(selected.get("mainClass"));
          String projectName = selected == null ? null : asString(selected.get("projectName"));
          if (mainClass == null || mainClass.isBlank()) {
            String baseName = program.getFileName().toString();
            baseName = baseName.contains(".") ? baseName.substring(0, baseName.lastIndexOf('.')) : baseName;
            mainClass = baseName;
          }
          arguments.put("mainClass", mainClass);
          if (projectName != null && !projectName.isBlank()) {
            arguments.put("projectName", projectName);
          }
      
          List<String> modulePaths = new ArrayList<>();
          List<String> classPaths = new ArrayList<>();
          Object classpathResult = null;
          try {
            classpathResult = invoke(client, RESOLVE_CLASSPATH,
                List.of(mainClass, projectName == null ? "" : projectName));
          }
          catch (Exception ignored) {
            classpathResult = null;
          }
          if (classpathResult instanceof List<?> entries) {
            if (entries.size() > 0 && entries.get(0) instanceof List<?> modules) {
              for (Object module : modules) {
                if (module != null) {
                  modulePaths.add(module.toString());
                }
              }
            }
            if (entries.size() > 1 && entries.get(1) instanceof List<?> paths) {
              for (Object path : paths) {
                if (path != null) {
                  classPaths.add(path.toString());
                }
              }
            }
          }
          if (!modulePaths.isEmpty()) {
            arguments.put("modulePaths", modulePaths);
          }
          if (classPaths.isEmpty() && parent != null) {
            classPaths.add(parent.toString());
          }
          if (!classPaths.isEmpty()) {
            arguments.put("classPaths", classPaths);
          }
          return arguments;
        }
      
        private static List<Map<String, Object>> resolveMainClasses(JavaDebugClient client, Path program)
            throws IOException, InterruptedException {
          Object result = invoke(client, RESOLVE_MAIN_CLASS, List.of(program.toUri().toString()));
          List<Map<String, Object>> entries = new ArrayList<>();
          if (result instanceof List<?> list) {
            for (Object element : list) {
              if (element instanceof Map<?, ?> map) {
                Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                for (Map.Entry<?, ?> value : map.entrySet()) {
                  if (value.getKey() != null) {
                    entry.put(value.getKey().toString(), value.getValue());
                  }
                }
                entries.add(entry);
              }
            }
          }
          return entries;
        }
      
        private static Map<String, Object> selectMainClass(List<Map<String, Object>> mainClasses, String fileName) {
          String baseName = fileName.contains(".") ? fileName.substring(0, fileName.lastIndexOf('.')) : fileName;
          for (Map<String, Object> entry : mainClasses) {
            String mainClass = asString(entry.get("mainClass"));
            if (mainClass == null) {
              continue;
            }
            String simpleName = mainClass.contains(".") ? mainClass.substring(mainClass.lastIndexOf('.') + 1)
                : mainClass;
            if (simpleName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).equals(baseName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
              return entry;
            }
          }
          return mainClasses.isEmpty() ? null : mainClasses.get(0);
        }
      
        private static Object invoke(JavaDebugClient client, String command, List<Object> arguments)
            throws IOException, InterruptedException {
          CompletableFuture<Object> future;
          try {
            future = client.executeCommand(command, arguments);
          }
          catch (RuntimeException error) {
            throw new IOException("The Java language server rejected the command " + command + ".", error);
          }
          try {
            return future.get(COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw error;
          }
          catch (TimeoutException error) {
            throw new IOException("The Java language server did not answer the command " + command + " in time.",
                error);
          }
          catch (ExecutionException error) {
            Throwable cause = error.getCause() == null ? error : error.getCause();
            throw new IOException("The Java language server failed the command " + command + ": " + cause.getMessage(),
                cause);
          }
        }
      
        private static Integer asPort(Object result) {
          if (result instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
          }
          if (result instanceof Map<?, ?> map && map.get("port") instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
          }
          return null;
        }
      
        private static String asString(Object value) {
          return value == null ? null : value.toString();
        }
      
      }

  content: |
      # Debug & LSP Fix TODO
      
      Scope: make run/debug work for standalone files (core feature) and fix all LSPs. CI debug validates all.
      
      ## Completed
      - Java debug standalone file: fallback main class = file base name, classpath = parent dir when JDT LS cannot resolve. File: `simpleide/src/main/java/io/simpleide/dap/JavaDebugBridge.java` (`launchArguments`).
      - Python debug: `debugpy` now launches with `console: integratedTerminal`, so `input()` reads from the I/O tab instead of the adapter stdin, and `justMyCode: false`, so stepping enters library code. Launch properties may now be JSON booleans/numbers, not only strings (`DapAdapter`, `DapRegistry`). Covered by `PythonDebugAdapterIntegrationTest.stepsIntoAFunctionAndForwardsStandardInput`.
      - Go debug standalone: `delve` launch uses `program: ${program}` instead of the source directory, so single files without a `go.mod` build. Covered by `GoDebugAdapterIntegrationTest.stopsAtABreakpointInAStandaloneFileWithoutAModule`.
      - Go LSP on host: added pinned `gopls` 0.16.2 entries for Go 1.21 to 1.25; the newest gopls is still selected on Go 1.26+. `LspManagerTest.selectsThePinnedGoplsReleaseForOlderGoToolchains`.
      - Kotlin LSP timeout: server initialization now allows 180 seconds (`LspClient.INITIALIZATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`), covering kotlin-language-server's initial indexing.
      - Groovy LSP: the Gradle build produces `groovy-language-server-<sha>-all.jar`, so the old fixed `groovy-language-server-all.jar` path never existed. The launch command now expands `${installDir}/**/*-all.jar`; `--quiet` was dropped so build failures are visible. Build verified manually with Java 21.
      - C# LSP: replaced `csharp-ls` (needed .NET SDK 10) with the Mono build of OmniSharp 1.39.12. It analyzes loose `.cs` files, uses the `${workspaceRoot}` command placeholder for `-s`, and needs only Mono 6+ plus an MSBuild instance (no .NET SDK).
      - CI debug workflow: `make test-lsp` runs the new `lsp`-tagged integration tests, and `.github/workflows/debug.yml` runs it after `make test-debug`.
      - Documentation: DAP, LSP, API and runtime docs updated for typed launch values, Python/Go debug behavior, OmniSharp, the gopls fallback, the 180-second initialization timeout and `${workspaceRoot}`.
      - Rust LSP loose files: `LspManager.getInitializationOptions` passes every loose `.rs` file of a workspace without a `Cargo.toml` or `rust-project.json` through rust-analyzer's `linkedProjects`, so a single-file Rust script gets semantic completion without any project structure. `LanguageServerManager` and the LSP test harness now send these options. rust-analyzer also needs the `rust-src` component: without it every completion response is `null`, even for a Cargo project. The Rust integration test skips with that hint when the component is missing, `LspManager` logs it once, and the Debug CI workflow installs a Rust toolchain with `rust-src`.
      - Documentation: `docs/reference/LSP.md` and `docs/api/lsp.md` describe the Rust `linkedProjects` behavior and the `rust-src` requirement.
      - C# loose files: OmniSharp only analyzes files that belong to a project. `LspManager.looseCSharpProject` writes `SimpleIdeLooseFiles.csproj` next to the loose `.cs` files when the folder has no `.sln`, `.csproj` or `.csx`. OmniSharp resolves projects from the document root, so the project must live in the workspace; `-s ${workspaceRoot}` is unchanged. `LspServerIntegrationTest` now requires a non-empty completion list, which is what exposed the empty C# response.
      - Groovy LSP install: `gradlew` was run with the install directory as working directory, so Gradle reported "does not contain a Gradle build". The post-install arguments now pass `-p <downloaded project directory>`; the server builds and answers completion.
      - CI language toolchains: the Debug workflow installs a Rust toolchain with `rust-src` and Mono with MSBuild from the Mono project repository (`mono-complete` brings `msbuild`), so the C# test runs instead of skipping.
      - Java snippets in the LSP popup: `JavaLspSnippets` adds `psvm`, `main`, `sout`, `fori` and `scanner` to the Java completion response (scanner picks the static/local declaration and adds the `java.util.Scanner` import). They are offered only for Java, never after a member-access dot, and only insert when accepted.
      - Java completion list ordering: snippet items carry descriptions, and `LspCompletionProvider` sorted with the inherited `compareTo` (which includes the description) while filtering with a binary search on the input text. `LspCompletion.compareTo` now compares input text only, so server completions are no longer dropped or reordered when labels repeat. Covered by `LspCompletionProviderTest` and `JavaLspSnippetsTest`.
      - LSP audit: every registry entry with an integration test now passes without skips — Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, Groovy, Rust, C#, C and C++. C and C++ (clangd) tests were added.
      - Rust run/debug: `CompilerLanguagesTest` compiles and runs standalone `.rs` files and forwards standard input through the managed output channel; both Rust tests pass (verified with rustc 1.94).
      
      ## Pending (scope by scope)
      
      No open scopes in this file. Follow-ups are tracked as issues instead.
      
      Notes for agents: read this file first; implement one scope per PR; run `make test-debug` and `make test-lsp`.

- path: Makefile
  content: |
      ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
      MVNW := mvnw.cmd
      PKG_RUNNER := powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1
      else
      MVNW := ./mvnw
      PKG_RUNNER := sh scripts/package.sh
      endif
      
      APP_JAR := simpleide/target/simpleide.jar
      PKG_DIR := simpleide/target/pkg
      VERSION := $(shell sed -n 's/^version=//p' simpleide/src/main/resources/simpleide.properties 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
      JAVA_OPTS ?= -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED
      
      .PHONY: all build test test-nolang test-debug test-lsp jar pkg pkg-verify change-version run clean format check-format format-check verify help
      
      all: test jar
      
      # Compile every module without running tests or packaging artifacts.
      build:
        $(MVNW) -B -DskipTests compile
      
      # Run the complete test suite.
      test: check-format
        $(MVNW) -B -DexcludedGroups=debug test
      
      # Run the test suite without tests that require external language toolchains.
      test-nolang: check-format
        $(MVNW) -B -DexcludedGroups=debug,language-tools test
      
      # Run only debug integration tests; the CI workflow supplies the newest toolchains.
      test-debug: check-format
        $(MVNW) -B -Dgroups=debug -DexcludedGroups= -Dsimpleide.java.debug.real=true test
      
      # Run only language-server integration tests; the CI workflow supplies the runtime toolchains.
      test-lsp: check-format
        $(MVNW) -B -Dgroups=lsp -DexcludedGroups= test
      
      # Package the executable fat JAR. Tests are intentionally not part of this target.
      jar:
        $(MVNW) -B -DskipTests package
        @echo "Fat JAR: $(APP_JAR)"
      
      # Build a self-contained jpackage application image for the current OS/arch.
      # Override with SIMPLEIDE_PKG_TYPE=deb|rpm|dmg|exe|msi|app-image.
      # The Windows .msi is built for x64 only.
      pkg: jar
        $(PKG_RUNNER)
      
      # Validates the packages produced by `make pkg` (zip, installers). Used by CI
      # so a broken executable never reaches a release.
      ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
      PKG_VERIFY := powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/validate-package.ps1
      else
      PKG_VERIFY := sh scripts/validate-package.sh
      endif
      
      pkg-verify: pkg
        $(PKG_VERIFY)
      
      # Changes the project version everywhere it is declared (pom files and the
      # application properties). Requires confirmation; the default answer is NO.
      change-version:
        @sh scripts/change-version.sh "$(VERSAO)"
      
      # Launch the executable fat JAR.
      run: jar
        java $(JAVA_OPTS) -jar "$(APP_JAR)"
      
      # Apply Spring Java Format and the repository's import ordering to every Java source.
      format:
        $(MVNW) -B spring-javaformat:apply
        java scripts/JavaImportFormatter.java --apply
      
      # Fail when Java sources violate Spring Java Format or the repository's import ordering.
      check-format:
        $(MVNW) -B spring-javaformat:validate
        java scripts/JavaImportFormatter.java --check
      
      # Backwards-compatible alias for check-format.
      format-check: check-format
      
      # Full local validation: formatting, tests and packaging.
      verify: check-format test jar
      
      clean:
        $(MVNW) -B clean
        rm -rf "$(PKG_DIR)"
      
      help:
        @echo "Simple IDE build targets"
        @echo ""
        @echo "  make build         Compile all modules (no tests, no packages)"
        @echo "  make test          Run the full test suite"
        @echo "  make test-nolang   Run tests without external language toolchains"
        @echo "  make test-debug    Run only debug integration tests"
        @echo "  make test-lsp      Run only language-server integration tests"
        @echo "  make jar           Package the executable fat JAR"
        @echo "  make pkg           Build every release package for this OS/architecture"
        @echo "  make pkg-verify    Build packages and validate the produced executables"
        @echo "  make change-version VERSION"
        @echo "                     Change the project version (asks for confirmation)"
        @echo "  make run           Launch the executable fat JAR"
        @echo "  make format        Apply Java source and import formatting"
        @echo "  make check-format  Check Java source and import formatting"
        @echo "  make format-check  Alias for check-format"
        @echo "  make verify        Check formatting, run tests and package"
        @echo "  make clean         Remove generated build and package outputs"
        @echo ""
        @echo "Version: $(VERSION)"
        @echo "Fat JAR: $(APP_JAR)"
        @echo "Package output: $(PKG_DIR)"

      package io.simpleide.dap;
      
      import java.nio.file.Files;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Map;
      import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
      
      import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
      import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;
      import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue;
      
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.TextDocumentItem;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
      
      import io.simpleide.language.config.LangPlatform;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.Output;
      import io.simpleide.lsp.client.LspClient;
      import io.simpleide.lsp.dowload.LspManager;
      
      /**
       * Debugs a real Java program through Eclipse JDT LS and the {@code vscode-java-debug}
       * plugin downloaded at runtime.
       *
       * <p>
       * The test starts the same language-server command the IDE uses, installs the newest
       * {@code vscode-java-debug} release compatible with the running JDK (see
       * {@link JavaDebugInstaller}), passes its bundle in the JDT LS
       * {@code initializationOptions}, asks the server to start a debug session and drives a
       * real launch through {@link JavaDebugBridge}. It is tagged {@code language-tools} and is
       * skipped when the platform cannot run JDT LS, when Java is older than 17, or when the
       * language server or adapter cannot be installed.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      @Tag("language-tools")
      @Tag("debug")
      class JavaRealDebugIntegrationTest {
      
        @TempDir
        Path tempDirectory;
      
        private final List<String> published = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
        private final List<String> events = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
        private AutoCloseable outputSubscription;
      
        @BeforeEach
        void subscribeToOutput() {
          published.clear();
          events.clear();
          outputSubscription = Output.getInstance().addListener(line -> published.add(line.text()));
        }
      
        @Test
        void stopsAtABreakpointAndFinishesARealJavaProgram() throws Exception {
          assumeTrue(Boolean.getBoolean("simpleide.java.debug.real"),
              "Real Java debug through jdtls is opt-in; run with -Dsimpleide.java.debug.real to enable");
          assumeTrue(Runtime.version().feature() >= 17, "JDT LS requires Java 17 or newer");
          DapAdapter adapter = DapRegistry.loadDefault().findForPlatform(LangPlatform.getCurrentPlatform(), "java");
          assumeTrue(adapter != null,
              "No Java debug adapter is registered for " + LangPlatform.getCurrentPlatform().getDisplayName());
      
          String source = """
              public class Main {
                  public static void main(String[] args) {
                      int value = 1;
                      int doubled = value * 2;
                      System.out.println("doubled=" + doubled);
                  }
              }
              """;
          Path program = Files.writeString(tempDirectory.resolve("Main.java"), source);
      
          List<String> command;
          Path bundle;
          try {
            command = LspManager.getComandRun("java", tempDirectory);
            bundle = JavaDebugInstaller.install();
          }
          catch (RuntimeException | java.io.IOException error) {
            assumeTrue(false,
                "The Java language server or debug adapter could not be installed: " + error.getMessage());
            return;
          }
          assumeTrue(!command.isEmpty(), "No Java language server is installed for this platform");
      
          LspClient client = new LspClient(command, tempDirectory, null, Map.of(), null,
              Map.of("bundles", List.of(bundle.toString())));
          try (AutoCloseable subscription = outputSubscription) {
            try {
              client.getInitialized().get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            }
            catch (java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException | java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException error) {
              assumeTrue(false, "The Java language server did not initialize: " + error.getMessage());
              return;
            }
            client.didOpen(new TextDocumentItem(program.toUri().toString(), "java", 1, source));
      
            JavaDebugBridge.JavaDebugClient bridgeClient = (commandId, arguments) -> client.executeCommand(commandId,
                arguments);
            DapSession session = JavaDebugBridge.start(bridgeClient, program, List.of(4), new DapSession.Listener() {
              @Override
              public void onStopped(int threadId, String reason) {
                events.add("stopped:" + reason);
              }
      
              @Override
              public void onTerminated() {
                events.add("terminated");
              }
            });
            try {
              await().atMost(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                .untilAsserted(() -> assertThat(events).contains("stopped:breakpoint"));
              session.resume();
              await().atMost(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS).untilAsserted(() -> assertThat(events).contains("terminated"));
              await().atMost(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                .untilAsserted(() -> assertThat(published).anyMatch(line -> line.contains("doubled=2")));
            }
            finally {
              session.close();
            }
          }
          finally {
            client.close();
          }
        }
      
      }

      package io.simpleide.dap;
      
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.net.ServerSocket;
      import java.nio.file.Files;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Locale;
      import java.util.Map;
      import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
      import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
      
      import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
      import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
      import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;
      
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
      
      import io.simpleide.language.io.Output;
      
      /**
       * Integration tests for the Java debug path that runs through the JDT language server.
       *
       * <p>
       * The tests stand in for the language server with a stub client that answers the same
       * workspace commands {@code jdtls} answers, but the debug adapter itself is a real
       * {@link FakeDapServer} process reached over TCP. This exercises the real handshake,
       * launch arguments and execution controls of the Java path without requiring a JDT
       * language server installation in the build environment.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      @Tag("debug")
      class JavaDebugBridgeIntegrationTest {
      
        @TempDir
        Path tempDirectory;
      
        private final List<String> published = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
        private AutoCloseable outputSubscription;
      
        private Process adapterProcess;
      
        @BeforeEach
        void subscribeToOutput() {
          published.clear();
          outputSubscription = Output.getInstance()
            .addListener(line -> published.add("[" + line.type() + "] " + line.text()));
        }
      
        @AfterEach
        void cleanUp() throws Exception {
          outputSubscription.close();
          if (adapterProcess != null) {
            adapterProcess.destroyForcibly();
            adapterProcess = null;
          }
        }
      
        @Test
        void startsAJavaDebugSessionAndDrivesIt() throws Exception {
          int port = freePort();
          adapterProcess = startAdapter(port);
          StubJavaClient client = new StubJavaClient(port);
          List<String> events = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
          DapSession session = JavaDebugBridge.start(client, program(), List.of(3), new DapSession.Listener() {
            @Override
            public void onStopped(int threadId, String reason) {
              events.add("stopped:" + reason);
            }
      
            @Override
            public void onTerminated() {
              events.add("terminated");
            }
          });
          try {
            assertThat(client.commands).containsExactly(JavaDebugBridge.START_DEBUG_SESSION,
                JavaDebugBridge.RESOLVE_MAIN_CLASS, JavaDebugBridge.RESOLVE_CLASSPATH);
            assertThat(client.commandArguments.get(1)).containsExactly(program().toUri().toString());
            assertThat(client.commandArguments.get(2)).containsExactly("com.example.App", "demo");
      
            awaitOutput("[OUTPUT] " + Output.INITIALIZED);
            awaitOutput("{LAUNCH} mainClass=com.example.App projectName=demo");
            awaitOutput("{BREAKPOINTS} 3");
            await().atMost(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS).untilAsserted(() -> assertThat(events).contains("stopped:breakpoint"));
      
            session.stepOver();
            awaitOutput("{CONTROL} next");
      
            session.stepInto();
            awaitOutput("{CONTROL} stepIn");
      
            session.stepOut();
            awaitOutput("{CONTROL} stepOut");
      
            session.resume();
            awaitOutput("{CONTROL} continue");
          }
          finally {
            session.close();
          }
        }
      
        @Test
        void failsWhenTheLanguageServerReturnsNoDebugPort() throws Exception {
          StubJavaClient client = new StubJavaClient(0);
      
          assertThatThrownBy(() -> JavaDebugBridge.start(client, program(), List.of(), null))
            .isInstanceOf(IOException.class)
            .hasMessageContaining("did not return a debug port");
          assertThat(client.commands).containsExactly(JavaDebugBridge.START_DEBUG_SESSION);
        }
      
        @Test
        void failsWhenNoMainClassCanBeResolved() throws Exception {
          StubJavaClient client = new StubJavaClient(1234);
          client.mainClasses = List.of();
      
          assertThatThrownBy(() -> JavaDebugBridge.launchArguments(client, program())).isInstanceOf(IOException.class)
            .hasMessageContaining("could not resolve a main class");
        }
      
        @Test
        void failsWhenTheLanguageServerRejectsTheCommand() throws Exception {
          JavaDebugBridge.JavaDebugClient client = (command, arguments) -> {
            throw new IllegalStateException("command not registered");
          };
      
          assertThatThrownBy(() -> JavaDebugBridge.startDebugSession(client)).isInstanceOf(IOException.class)
            .hasMessageContaining("rejected the command");
        }
      
        private void awaitOutput(String fragment) {
          await().atMost(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .untilAsserted(() -> assertThat(published).as("output lines").anyMatch(line -> line.contains(fragment)));
        }
      
        private Path program() throws IOException {
          Path program = tempDirectory.resolve("App.java");
          if (!Files.exists(program)) {
            Files.writeString(program, "package com.example;\n\npublic class App {\n}\n");
          }
          return program;
        }
      
        private Process startAdapter(int port) throws IOException {
          ProcessBuilder builder = new ProcessBuilder(javaExecutable(), "-cp", classpath(), FakeDapServer.class.getName(),
              "tcp", Integer.toString(port));
          builder.redirectErrorStream(true);
          return builder.start();
        }
      
        private static int freePort() throws IOException {
          try (ServerSocket socket = new ServerSocket(0)) {
            return socket.getLocalPort();
          }
        }
      
        private static String javaExecutable() {
          String executable = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win") ? "java.exe"
              : "java";
          return Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", executable).toString();
        }
      
        private static String classpath() {
          return System.getProperty("java.class.path");
        }
      
        /**
         * Language server stub that answers the commands issued by {@link JavaDebugBridge}.
         */
        private static final class StubJavaClient implements JavaDebugBridge.JavaDebugClient {
      
          private final int port;
      
          private final List<String> commands = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
          private final List<List<Object>> commandArguments = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
          private List<Map<String, Object>> mainClasses = List
            .of(Map.of("mainClass", "com.example.App", "projectName", "demo"));
      
          private StubJavaClient(int port) {
            this.port = port;
          }
      
          @Override
          public CompletableFuture<Object> executeCommand(String command, List<Object> arguments) {
            commands.add(command);
            commandArguments.add(arguments);
            return switch (command) {
              case JavaDebugBridge.START_DEBUG_SESSION -> CompletableFuture.completedFuture(port);
              case JavaDebugBridge.RESOLVE_MAIN_CLASS -> CompletableFuture.completedFuture(mainClasses);
              case JavaDebugBridge.RESOLVE_CLASSPATH ->
                CompletableFuture.completedFuture(List.of(List.of(), List.of("/workspace/classes")));
              default -> CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
            };
          }
      
        }
      
      }

        /**
         * Adds the IDE's Java snippets to the items returned by the server.
         * @param items completions returned by the language server
         * @return the merged completions, or the original list when no snippet applies
         */
        private List<CompletionItem> withSnippets(List<CompletionItem> items) {
          if (!JavaLspSnippets.supports(document.getLanguageId())) {
            return items;
          }
          List<CompletionItem> snippets = JavaLspSnippets.completions(editor.getText(), editor.getCaretPosition());
          if (snippets.isEmpty()) {
            return items;
          }
          List<CompletionItem> merged = new ArrayList<>(snippets);
          merged.addAll(items);
          return merged;
        }
      
        /**
         * Requests document formatting and applies the returned edits on the EDT.
         * @return a future that completes when the formatting request is handled
         */
        public CompletableFuture<Void> formatDocument() {
          if (closed) {
            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
          }
      
          DocumentFormattingParams params = new DocumentFormattingParams(new TextDocumentIdentifier(document.getUri()),
              new FormattingOptions(4, true));
      
          return client.formatting(params).thenAcceptAsync(edits -> {
            if (edits == null || edits.isEmpty() || closed) {
              return;
            }
      
            ThreadMaster.getInstance().executeOnEDT(() -> applyFormattingEdits(edits));
          }, ThreadMaster.getInstance()::executeOnEDT);
        }
      
        private void applyFormattingEdits(List<? extends TextEdit> edits) {
          for (int i = edits.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            TextEdit edit = edits.get(i);
            try {
              int start = positionToOffset(edit.getRange().getStart());
              int end = positionToOffset(edit.getRange().getEnd());
              editor.replaceRange(edit.getNewText(), start, end);
            }
            catch (Exception error) {
              LOGGER.warn("Erro ao aplicar formatação do LSP em {}.", document.getUri(), error);
            }

      package io.simpleide.utils;
      
      import java.io.File;
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.nio.file.Files;
      import java.nio.file.InvalidPathException;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.ArrayList;
      import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
      import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Locale;
      import java.util.Map;
      import java.util.Optional;
      import java.util.Set;
      import java.util.regex.Matcher;
      import java.util.regex.Pattern;
      
      /**
       * Locates a usable Java runtime for launching helper processes.
       *
       * <p>
       * A development launch runs on a full JDK, so {@code java.home/bin/java} is enough. A
       * jpackage image used to strip the native launchers from its runtime; this helper
       * therefore also accepts an explicit home, {@code JAVA_HOME}, the current process command
       * and {@code PATH}, and never assumes that {@code java.home} contains a launcher.
       * Packaging now keeps the launchers with
       * {@code --jlink-options "--strip-debug --no-man-pages --no-header-files"}, but the
       * fallbacks keep older images and custom runtimes working.
       *
       * <p>
       * The embedded bytecode compiler and the Java language server both need the
       * {@code jdk.compiler} module, so {@link #jdkHome()} and {@link #jdkJavaExecutable()}
       * only accept a runtime that provides it.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.0.0beta
       */
      public final class JavaRuntime {
      
        /**
         * System property that overrides the Java home used for helper processes.
         */
        public static final String JAVA_HOME_PROPERTY = "simpleide.javaHome";
      
        /**
         * System property kept for compatibility with the language server settings.
         */
        public static final String LSP_JAVA_HOME_PROPERTY = "simpleide.lsp.javaHome";
      
        private static final String[] HOME_PROPERTIES = { JAVA_HOME_PROPERTY, LSP_JAVA_HOME_PROPERTY };
      
        private static final String[] HOME_ENVIRONMENT = { "SIMPLEIDE_JAVA_HOME", "JAVA_HOME", "JDK_HOME" };
      
        private static final boolean WINDOWS = System.getProperty("os.name", "").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win");
      
        private static final String JAVA_EXECUTABLE = WINDOWS ? "java.exe" : "java";
      
        private static final String JAVAC_EXECUTABLE = WINDOWS ? "javac.exe" : "javac";
      
        private static final Pattern MODULES_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("MODULES=\"([^\"]*)\"");
      
        private JavaRuntime() {
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the Java launcher to use for helper processes.
         *
         * <p>
         * A runtime with {@code jdk.compiler} is preferred. A plain JRE is used only as a
         * last resort, when no JDK can be found.
         * @return the launcher path, or an empty optional when no Java runtime is available
         */
        public static Optional<Path> javaExecutable() {
          Optional<Path> jdk = jdkJavaExecutable();
          if (jdk.isPresent()) {
            return jdk;
          }
          return candidateHomes().stream().map(JavaRuntime::javaExecutable).flatMap(Optional::stream).findFirst();
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the home of the first usable JDK.
         * @return the JDK home, or an empty optional when no JDK is available
         */
        public static Optional<Path> jdkHome() {
          return firstJdk(candidateHomes());
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the Java launcher from a usable JDK.
         * @return the JDK launcher path, or an empty optional when no JDK is available
         */
        public static Optional<Path> jdkJavaExecutable() {
          return jdkHome().map(home -> home.resolve("bin").resolve(JAVA_EXECUTABLE));
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the {@code javac} launcher from a usable JDK.
         * @return the compiler path, or an empty optional when no JDK with the launcher is
         * available
         */
        public static Optional<Path> jdkJavacExecutable() {
          return jdkHome().map(home -> home.resolve("bin").resolve(JAVAC_EXECUTABLE))
            .filter(JavaRuntime::isExecutableFile);
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the environment overrides needed by Java-based helper processes.
         * @return a map containing {@code JAVA_HOME} when a JDK is available, otherwise an
         * empty map
         */
        public static Map<String, String> environment() {
          Optional<Path> home = jdkHome();
          if (home.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
          }
          Map<String, String> environment = new LinkedHashMap<>();
          environment.put("JAVA_HOME", home.get().toString());
          return environment;
        }
      
        /**
         * Tells whether a configured command refers to the bare {@code java} launcher.
         * @param command command name or path
         * @return {@code true} for {@code java} and {@code java.exe}
         */
        public static boolean isJavaCommand(String command) {
          if (command == null) {
            return false;
          }
          String normalized = command.strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
          return "java".equals(normalized) || "java.exe".equals(normalized);
        }
      
        /**
         * Tells whether a directory contains a Java launcher and the {@code jdk.compiler}
         * module.
         * @param home candidate Java home
         * @return {@code true} when the directory is a usable JDK
         */
        static boolean isJdkHome(Path home) {
          if (!javaExecutable(home).isPresent()) {
            return false;
          }
          if (isExecutableFile(home.resolve("bin").resolve(JAVAC_EXECUTABLE))) {
            return true;
          }
          return hasCompilerModule(home);
        }
      
        static Optional<Path> javaExecutable(Path home) {
          if (home == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
          }
          Path executable = home.resolve("bin").resolve(JAVA_EXECUTABLE);
          return isExecutableFile(executable) ? Optional.of(executable.toAbsolutePath().normalize()) : Optional.empty();
        }
      
        static Optional<Path> firstJdk(List<Path> homes) {
          return homes.stream().filter(JavaRuntime::isJdkHome).findFirst();
        }
      
        static List<Path> candidateHomes() {
          Set<Path> candidates = new LinkedHashSet<>();
          for (String property : HOME_PROPERTIES) {
            addHome(candidates, System.getProperty(property));
          }
          for (String variable : HOME_ENVIRONMENT) {
            addHome(candidates, System.getenv(variable));
          }
      
          ProcessHandle.current().info().command().ifPresent(command -> {
            try {
              Path executable = Path.of(command);
              if (isJavaExecutableName(executable.getFileName())) {
                Path bin = executable.getParent();
                if (bin != null && bin.getParent() != null) {
                  addHome(candidates, bin.getParent().toString());
                }
              }
            }
            catch (InvalidPathException ignored) {
              // Ignore unusable platform command paths.
            }
          });
      
          addHome(candidates, System.getProperty("java.home"));
      
          String pathEnvironment = System.getenv("PATH");
          if (pathEnvironment != null) {
            for (String entry : pathEnvironment.split(File.pathSeparator)) {
              if (entry.isBlank()) {
                continue;
              }
              try {
                Path directory = Path.of(entry);
                Path name = directory.getFileName();
                if (name != null && "bin".equalsIgnoreCase(name.toString()) && directory.getParent() != null) {
                  addHome(candidates, directory.getParent().toString());
                }
                else {
                  addHome(candidates, entry);
                }
              }
              catch (InvalidPathException ignored) {
                // Ignore malformed PATH entries.
              }
            }
          }
      
          return new ArrayList<>(candidates);
        }
      
        private static void addHome(Set<Path> candidates, String value) {
          if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return;
          }
          String expanded = value.strip();
          if (expanded.startsWith("~/") || expanded.startsWith("~\\")) {
            expanded = System.getProperty("user.home") + expanded.substring(1);
          }
          try {
            candidates.add(Path.of(expanded).toAbsolutePath().normalize());
          }
          catch (InvalidPathException ignored) {
            // Ignore malformed configuration values.
          }
        }
      
        private static boolean isJavaExecutableName(Path fileName) {
          return fileName != null && JAVA_EXECUTABLE.equalsIgnoreCase(fileName.toString());
        }
      
        private static boolean isExecutableFile(Path path) {
          return Files.isRegularFile(path) && Files.isExecutable(path);
        }
      
        private static boolean hasCompilerModule(Path home) {
          Path release = home.resolve("release");
          if (!Files.isRegularFile(release)) {
            return false;
          }
          try {
            Matcher matcher = MODULES_PATTERN.matcher(Files.readString(release));
            if (!matcher.find()) {
              return false;
            }
            for (String module : matcher.group(1).split("\\s+")) {
              if ("jdk.compiler".equals(module)) {
                return true;
              }
            }
          }
          catch (IOException ignored) {
            // Fall through to the missing-compiler result.
          }
          return false;
        }
      
      }

      package io.simpleide.dap;
      
      import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.io.InputStream;
      import java.io.OutputStream;
      import java.net.ServerSocket;
      import java.net.Socket;
      import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.ArrayList;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Locale;
      
      import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
      import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
      import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode;
      import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
      
      /**
       * Scripted Debug Adapter Protocol server used by the DAP integration tests.
       *
       * <p>
       * The server speaks real DAP framing over standard input/output or TCP and behaves like a
       * small but complete debug adapter: it completes the {@code initialize} handshake,
       * answers {@code launch}, records {@code setBreakpoints}, reports a {@code stopped} event
       * after {@code configurationDone}, and answers every execution control request
       * ({@code continue}, {@code next}, {@code stepIn}, {@code stepOut}, {@code pause},
       * {@code threads} and {@code stackTrace}) with the events a real adapter emits.
       *
       * <p>
       * Every control request is echoed as a {@code stdout} output event ({@code {CONTROL}
       * next} and so on), so tests can observe from the IDE output queue that the adapter
       * really received the command. The same technique reports the breakpoint set the client
       * sent. When started with {@code --stdin-echo <classpath>} the adapter asks the client to
       * start {@link EchoStdin} through {@code runInTerminal}, which lets tests exercise real
       * standard input forwarding against a live debuggee process.
       *
       * <p>
       * It is launched as a child process, which keeps the tests independent of any external
       * debug adapter.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      public final class FakeDapServer {
      
        private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
      
        private final InputStream input;
      
        private final OutputStream output;
      
        private final String echoClasspath;
      
        private final boolean terminateAfterStop;
      
        private final List<Integer> breakpoints = new ArrayList<>();
      
        private int sequence;
      
        private int currentLine = 1;
      
        private boolean terminatedSent;
      
        FakeDapServer(InputStream input, OutputStream output, String echoClasspath, boolean terminateAfterStop) {
          this.input = new BufferedInputStream(input);
          this.output = output;
          this.echoClasspath = echoClasspath;
          this.terminateAfterStop = terminateAfterStop;
        }
      
        /**
         * Runs the fake adapter.
         * @param args {@code tcp <port>} for a TCP server (or no arguments for stdio), plus
         * optional {@code --stdin-echo <classpath>}
         * @throws IOException when the transport cannot be opened
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
          int port = 0;
          String echoClasspath = null;
          boolean tcp = false;
          boolean terminateAfterStop = false;
          for (int index = 0; index < args.length; index++) {
            switch (args[index]) {
              case "tcp" -> {
                tcp = true;
                if (index + 1 < args.length) {
                  port = Integer.parseInt(args[++index]);
                }
              }
              case "--stdin-echo" -> {
                if (index + 1 < args.length) {
                  echoClasspath = args[++index];
                }
              }
              case "--terminate-after-stop" -> terminateAfterStop = true;
              default -> {
                // Unknown arguments are ignored so the adapter stays launchable from
                // registry templates that append extra options.
              }
            }
          }
          if (!tcp) {
            new FakeDapServer(System.in, System.out, echoClasspath, terminateAfterStop).serve();
            return;
          }
          try (ServerSocket serverSocket = new ServerSocket(port); Socket socket = serverSocket.accept()) {
            new FakeDapServer(socket.getInputStream(), socket.getOutputStream(), echoClasspath, terminateAfterStop)
              .serve();
          }
        }
      
        private void serve() throws IOException {
          JsonNode message;
          while ((message = readMessage()) != null) {
            if ("request".equals(message.path("type").asText())) {
              handleRequest(message);
            }
            // Responses to requests issued by the client (runInTerminal) need no answer.
          }
          output.flush();
        }
      
        private void handleRequest(JsonNode message) throws IOException {
          String command = message.path("command").asText();
          int requestSequence = message.path("seq").asInt();
          switch (command) {
            case "initialize" -> {
              ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              body.put("supportsConfigurationDoneRequest", true);
              body.put("supportsTerminateRequest", true);
              body.put("supportsRunInTerminalRequest", true);
              respond(requestSequence, command, body);
              event("initialized", MAPPER.createObjectNode());
            }
            case "launch" -> {
              respond(requestSequence, command, null);
              JsonNode arguments = message.path("arguments");
              if (arguments.hasNonNull("mainClass")) {
                publish("{LAUNCH} mainClass=" + arguments.path("mainClass").asText() + " projectName="
                    + arguments.path("projectName").asText());
              }
              if (echoClasspath != null) {
                requestRunInTerminal();
              }
            }
            case "setBreakpoints" -> {
              breakpoints.clear();
              JsonNode requested = message.path("arguments").path("breakpoints");
              ArrayNode verified = MAPPER.createArrayNode();
              int id = 1;
              for (JsonNode breakpoint : requested) {
                int line = breakpoint.path("line").asInt();
                breakpoints.add(line);
                ObjectNode entry = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
                entry.put("id", id++);
                entry.put("verified", true);
                entry.put("line", line);
                verified.add(entry);
              }
              ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              body.set("breakpoints", verified);
              respond(requestSequence, command, body);
              publish("{BREAKPOINTS} " + joinedBreakpoints());
            }
            case "configurationDone" -> {
              respond(requestSequence, command, null);
              publish("{CONFIGURED}");
              stopped("breakpoint");
              if (terminateAfterStop) {
                terminated();
              }
            }
            case "continue" -> {
              ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              body.put("allThreadsContinued", true);
              respond(requestSequence, command, body);
              publish("{CONTROL} continue");
              event("continued", MAPPER.createObjectNode());
              advance();
              stopped(breakpoints.isEmpty() ? "step" : "breakpoint");
            }
            case "next", "stepIn", "stepOut" -> {
              respond(requestSequence, command, null);
              publish("{CONTROL} " + command);
              advance();
              stopped("step");
            }
            case "pause" -> {
              respond(requestSequence, command, null);
              publish("{CONTROL} pause");
              stopped("pause");
            }
            case "threads" -> {
              ObjectNode thread = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              thread.put("id", 1);
              thread.put("name", "main");
              ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              ArrayNode threads = MAPPER.createArrayNode();
              threads.add(thread);
              body.set("threads", threads);
              respond(requestSequence, command, body);
            }
            case "stackTrace" -> {
              ObjectNode frame = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              frame.put("id", 1);
              frame.put("name", "main");
              frame.put("line", currentLine);
              frame.put("column", 1);
              ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
              ArrayNode frames = MAPPER.createArrayNode();
              frames.add(frame);
              body.set("stackFrames", frames);
              body.put("totalFrames", 1);
              respond(requestSequence, command, body);
            }
            case "disconnect" -> {
              respond(requestSequence, command, null);
              terminated();
              output.flush();
              System.exit(0);
            }
            default -> respond(requestSequence, command, null);
          }
        }
      
        private void advance() {
          currentLine++;
        }
      
        private String joinedBreakpoints() {
          StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
          for (Integer line : breakpoints) {
            if (text.length() > 0) {
              text.append(',');
            }
            text.append(line);
          }
          return text.toString();
        }
      
        private void requestRunInTerminal() throws IOException {
          String executable = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win") ? "java.exe"
              : "java";
          String javaExecutable = Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", executable).toString();
          ObjectNode arguments = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          arguments.put("kind", "integrated");
          arguments.put("title", "Echo stdin");
          ArrayNode args = arguments.putArray("args");
          args.add(javaExecutable);
          args.add("-cp");
          args.add(echoClasspath);
          args.add(EchoStdin.class.getName());
      
          ObjectNode request = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          request.put("seq", ++sequence);
          request.put("type", "request");
          request.put("command", "runInTerminal");
          request.set("arguments", arguments);
          send(request);
        }
      
        private void stopped(String reason) throws IOException {
          ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          body.put("reason", reason);
          body.put("threadId", 1);
          body.put("allThreadsStopped", true);
          ObjectNode event = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          event.put("type", "event");
          event.put("event", "stopped");
          event.set("body", body);
          send(event);
        }
      
        private void terminated() throws IOException {
          if (terminatedSent) {
            return;
          }
          terminatedSent = true;
          event("terminated", MAPPER.createObjectNode());
        }
      
        private void publish(String text) throws IOException {
          ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          body.put("category", "stdout");
          body.put("output", text + "\n");
          event("output", body);
        }
      
        private void event(String name, ObjectNode body) throws IOException {
          ObjectNode node = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          node.put("seq", ++sequence);
          node.put("type", "event");
          node.put("event", name);
          if (body != null && !body.isEmpty()) {
            node.set("body", body);
          }
          send(node);
        }
      
        private void respond(int requestSequence, String command, ObjectNode body) throws IOException {
          ObjectNode node = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
          node.put("seq", ++sequence);
          node.put("type", "response");
          node.put("request_seq", requestSequence);
          node.put("success", true);
          node.put("command", command);
          if (body != null) {
            node.set("body", body);
          }
          send(node);
        }
      
        private void send(JsonNode node) throws IOException {
          byte[] body = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(node).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
          output.write(("Content-Length: " + body.length + "\r\n\r\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
          output.write(body);
          output.flush();
        }
      
        private JsonNode readMessage() throws IOException {
          StringBuilder header = new StringBuilder();
          int read;
          while ((read = input.read()) != -1) {
            header.append((char) read);
            if (header.length() >= 4 && header.charAt(header.length() - 4) == '\r'
                && header.charAt(header.length() - 3) == '\n' && header.charAt(header.length() - 2) == '\r'
                && header.charAt(header.length() - 1) == '\n') {
              break;
            }
          }
          if (read == -1) {
            return null;
          }
          int length = contentLength(header.toString());
          if (length < 0) {
            return null;
          }
          byte[] body = input.readNBytes(length);
          if (body.length < length) {
            return null;
          }
          return MAPPER.readTree(body);
        }
      
        private static int contentLength(String header) {
          for (String line : header.split("\r\n")) {
            int colon = line.indexOf(':');
            if (colon > 0 && "content-length".equalsIgnoreCase(line.substring(0, colon).trim())) {
              try {
                return Integer.parseInt(line.substring(colon + 1).trim());
              }
              catch (NumberFormatException error) {
                return -1;
              }
            }
          }
          return -1;
        }
      
      }

      package io.simpleide.lsp;
      
      import java.nio.file.Files;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.ArrayList;

      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.Position;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.PublishDiagnosticsParams;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.TextDocumentIdentifier;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.TextDocumentItem;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.jsonrpc.messages.Either;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
      
      import io.simpleide.dap.JavaDebugBridge;
      import io.simpleide.lsp.client.LspClient;
      import io.simpleide.lsp.client.LspCompletionProvider;
      import io.simpleide.lsp.dowload.LspManager;
      import io.simpleide.thread.ThreadMaster;
      import io.simpleide.ui.editor.Editor;
      
      import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
      
      @Tag("debug")
      class JavaLooseFileProbeTest {
      
        private static final String SOURCE = """
            public class Main {
                public static void main(String[] args) {
                    p
                }
            }
            """;
      
        @BeforeAll
        @SuppressWarnings("unused")
        static void initializeThreadManager() {
          ThreadMaster.getInstance().initialize();
        }
      
        @TempDir
        Path tempDirectory;
      
        @Test
        void probesLooseFileSupport() throws Exception {
          Path program = Files.writeString(tempDirectory.resolve("Main.java"), SOURCE);
          List<String> diagnostics = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
          List<String> command = LspManager.getComandRun("java", tempDirectory);
          LspClient client = new LspClient(command, tempDirectory, (params) -> record(params, diagnostics), Map.of(),
              null, Map.of());
          try {
            client.getInitialized().get(180, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            System.out.println("PROBE initialized");
            String uri = program.toUri().toString();
            client.didOpen(new TextDocumentItem(uri, "java", 1, SOURCE));
      
            CompletionParams params = new CompletionParams(new TextDocumentIdentifier(uri), new Position(2, 9));
            Either<List<CompletionItem>, CompletionList> completion = client.completion(params)
              .get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            List<CompletionItem> items = completion == null ? null
                : completion.isLeft() ? completion.getLeft() : completion.getRight().getItems();
            System.out.println("PROBE completion count=" + (items == null ? "null" : items.size()));
            if (items != null) {
              items.stream()
                .limit(12)
                .forEach(item -> System.out
                  .println("PROBE item=" + item.getLabel() + " filter=" + item.getFilterText() + " edit="
                      + item.getTextEdit() + " insert=" + item.getInsertText()));
              List<CompletionItem> withSnippets = new ArrayList<>(JavaLspSnippetsAccess.completions(SOURCE, 9));
              withSnippets.addAll(items);
              SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> {
                Editor editor = new Editor();
                editor.setText(SOURCE);
                editor.setCaretPosition(SOURCE.indexOf("        p") + 9);
                LspCompletionProvider provider = new LspCompletionProvider();
                provider.setItems(withSnippets);
                List<String> shown = provider.getCompletions(editor)
                  .stream()
                  .map(completion_ -> completion_.getInputText())
                  .toList();
                System.out.println("PROBE popup count=" + shown.size() + " shown=" + shown);
              });
            }
      
            Object main = client.executeCommand(JavaDebugBridge.RESOLVE_MAIN_CLASS, List.of(uri))
              .get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            System.out.println("PROBE resolveMainClass=" + main);
          }
          finally {
            client.close();
          }
        }
      
        private static void record(PublishDiagnosticsParams params, List<String> diagnostics) {
          params.getDiagnostics()
            .forEach(diagnostic -> diagnostics.add(diagnostic.getSeverity() + ":" + diagnostic.getMessage()));
        }
      
        /**
         * Reaches the package-private snippet helper from the LSP test package.
         */
        private static final class JavaLspSnippetsAccess {
      
          private static List<CompletionItem> completions(String text, int caret) throws Exception {
            Class<?> type = Class.forName("io.simpleide.lsp.client.JavaLspSnippets");
            var method = type.getDeclaredMethod("completions", String.class, int.class);
            method.setAccessible(true);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            List<CompletionItem> result = (List<CompletionItem>) method.invoke(null, text, caret);
            return result;
          }
      
        }
      
      }

> _Reasoning_
> The real test doesn't initialize ThreadMaster. `ThreadMaster.getInstance()` is used inside LspClient constructor — in the probe test it explicitly initializes ThreadMaster in @BeforeAll. Without initialization, registration may queue work that never runs? The real test did create node ids in logs ("Registered thread node id=2 level=1"), so something ran. But maybe the startup task never executes because the thread master's scheduler isn't initialized... The probe test's init matters.
> 
> Check ThreadMaster.initialize and getInstance. Perhaps without initialize, nodes register but startup executes anyway? Log at 17:55:40 suggests a node registered at timeout. 90s wait then node id=4 appears — that's likely the awaitility/timeout thread.
> 
> Simplest: add ThreadMaster.initialize() in @BeforeAll in JavaRealDebugIntegrationTest, mirroring the probe. Let me check ThreadMaster quickly.

- path: simpleide/src/test/java/io/simpleide/lsp/LspIntegrationHarness.java
  content: |
      package io.simpleide.lsp;
      
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
      import java.nio.file.Files;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.nio.file.Paths;
      import java.util.ArrayList;
      import java.util.HashMap;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Map;
      import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
      
      import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
      import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;
      import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue;
      
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.CompletionItem;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.CompletionList;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.CompletionParams;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.Position;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.TextDocumentIdentifier;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.TextDocumentItem;
      import org.eclipse.lsp4j.jsonrpc.messages.Either;
      
      import io.simpleide.lsp.client.LspClient;
      import io.simpleide.lsp.dowload.LspManager;
      
      /**
       * Shared setup for language-server integration tests.
       *
       * <p>
       * The harness starts the same command the IDE resolves for a language, waits for the LSP
       * handshake and answers a completion request against a real document. Tests skip when the
       * language runtime required by the server is missing or when the platform has no server
       * definition, following the convention used by the debug adapter integration tests.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      final class LspIntegrationHarness {
      
        private static final long STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 180;
      
        private LspIntegrationHarness() {
        }
      
        /**
         * Skips the test when a runtime command required by the server is not installed.
         * @param command command to probe
         * @param arguments arguments passed to the command
         */
        static void requireToolchain(String command, String... arguments) {
          assumeTrue(isAvailable(command, arguments),
              command + " is required by the language server but is not available");
        }
      
        /**
         * Checks whether a command can be executed successfully.
         * @param command command to probe
         * @param arguments arguments passed to the command
         * @return {@code true} when the command exits with status zero
         */
        static boolean isAvailable(String command, String... arguments) {
          List<String> commandLine = new ArrayList<>();
          commandLine.add(command);
          commandLine.addAll(List.of(arguments));
          try {
            Process process = new ProcessBuilder(commandLine).redirectErrorStream(true)
              .redirectOutput(ProcessBuilder.Redirect.DISCARD)
              .start();
            return process.waitFor(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS) && process.exitValue() == 0;
          }
          catch (IOException error) {
            return false;
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return false;
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Checks whether the {@code rust-src} component is installed.
         *
         * <p>
         * Without it, rust-analyzer cannot load the standard library and answers every
         * completion request with a {@code null} result, even for a Cargo project.
         * @return {@code true} when the sysroot ships the standard library sources
         */
        static boolean hasRustSources() {
          List<String> command = List.of("rustc", "--print", "sysroot");
          try {
            Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command).redirectErrorStream(true).start();
            String output = new String(process.getInputStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
            if (!process.waitFor(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS) || process.exitValue() != 0 || output.isBlank()) {
              return false;
            }
            return Files.isDirectory(Paths.get(output, "lib", "rustlib", "src", "rust", "library"));
          }
          catch (IOException error) {
            return false;
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return false;
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts the language server resolved for a language and waits for initialization.
         * @param languageId LSP language identifier
         * @param workspace workspace root
         * @param initializationOptions options sent in the {@code initialize} request
         * @return the initialized client; the caller must close it
         */
        static LspClient start(String languageId, Path workspace, Map<String, Object> initializationOptions) {
          Map<String, Object> options = new HashMap<>(LspManager.getInitializationOptions(languageId, workspace));
          options.putAll(initializationOptions);
          List<String> command;
          try {
            command = LspManager.getComandRun(languageId, workspace);
          }
          catch (RuntimeException error) {
            assumeTrue(false, "The " + languageId + " language server could not be installed: " + error.getMessage());
            return null;
          }
          assumeTrue(!command.isEmpty(), "No " + languageId + " language server is registered for this platform");
      
          LspClient client;
          try {
            client = new LspClient(command, workspace, null, Map.of(), null, options);
          }
          catch (IOException error) {
            assumeTrue(false, "The " + languageId + " language server could not be started: " + error.getMessage());
            return null;
          }
          try {
            client.getInitialized().get(STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            return client;
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            client.close();
            throw new AssertionError("Interrupted while initializing the " + languageId + " language server", error);
          }
          catch (ExecutionException | TimeoutException error) {
            client.close();
            throw new AssertionError("The " + languageId + " language server did not initialize: " + error.getMessage(),
                error);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Opens a document and checks that the server answers a completion request.
         * @param client initialized client
         * @param languageId LSP language identifier
         * @param file opened file
         * @param content file content
         * @param position completion position
         */
        static void assertAnswersCompletion(LspClient client, String languageId, Path file, String content,
            Position position) {
          String uri = file.toUri().toString();
          client.didOpen(new TextDocumentItem(uri, languageId, 1, content));
          CompletionParams params = new CompletionParams(new TextDocumentIdentifier(uri), position);
      
          await().atMost(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS).pollInterval(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS).untilAsserted(() -> {
            try {
              Either<List<CompletionItem>, CompletionList> completion = client.completion(params)
                .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
              assertThat(completion).as("%s completion response", languageId).isNotNull();
              List<CompletionItem> items = completion.isLeft() ? completion.getLeft()
                  : completion.getRight() == null ? null : completion.getRight().getItems();
              assertThat(items).as("%s completion items", languageId).isNotNull().isNotEmpty();
            }
            catch (ExecutionException error) {
              throw new AssertionError(
                  "The " + languageId + " language server rejected the completion request: " + error.getMessage(),
                  error);
            }
          });
        }
      
      }
