        }
      
        /**
         * Builds the command line used to start the adapter.
         * @param installDirectory directory where the adapter was installed
         * @param program program being debugged
         * @param port TCP port used by server-style adapters, or {@code 0} when unused
         * @return the command followed by its resolved arguments
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public List<String> commandLine(String installDirectory, String program, int port) {
          List<String> commandLine = new ArrayList<>();
          commandLine.add(resolve(command, installDirectory, program, port));
          for (String argument : arguments) {
            commandLine.add(resolve(argument, installDirectory, program, port));
          }
          return commandLine;
        }
      
        /**
         * Builds the environment variables used to start the adapter.
         * @param installDirectory directory where the adapter was installed
         * @param program program being debugged
         * @param port TCP port used by server-style adapters, or {@code 0} when unused
         * @return the immutable resolved environment map
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public Map<String, String> environment(String installDirectory, String program, int port) {
          Map<String, String> resolved = new LinkedHashMap<>();
          for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : environment.entrySet()) {
            resolved.put(entry.getKey(), resolve(entry.getValue(), installDirectory, program, port));
          }
          return Map.copyOf(resolved);
        }
      
        private static String resolve(String value, String installDirectory, String program, int port) {
          return value.replace("${installDir}", installDirectory == null ? "" : installDirectory)
            .replace("${program}", program == null ? "" : program)
            .replace("${port}", Integer.toString(port));
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the stable adapter identifier.
         * @return the identifier
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getId() {
          return id;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the human-readable adapter name.
         * @return the adapter name
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getName() {
          return name;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the adapter version.
         * @return the version, possibly empty
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getVersion() {
          return version;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the language identifier this adapter debugs.
         * @return the language identifier, or an empty string when the adapter is not bound
         * to a language
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getLanguageId() {
          return languageId;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns whether the adapter debugs a language.
         * @param candidate language identifier to compare
         * @return {@code true} when the adapter is bound to the supplied language
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean supportsLanguage(String candidate) {
          return candidate != null && candidate.equals(languageId);
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the launch command template.
         * @return the command template
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getCommand() {
          return command;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the launch argument templates.
         * @return the immutable argument list
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public List<String> getArguments() {
          return arguments;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns every platform download entry.
         * @return the immutable download list
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public List<DapDownload> getDownloads() {
          return downloads;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the communication transport used by the adapter.
         * @return {@code stdio} or {@code tcp}
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getTransport() {
          return transport;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the extra properties merged into the launch request.
         * @return the immutable launch property map
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public Map<String, Object> getLaunchArguments() {
          return launchArguments;
        }
      
        /**
         * Resolves the launch properties for a program, expanding the {@code ${program}} and
         * {@code ${fileDir}} placeholders.
         * @param program program being debugged
         * @return the resolved launch properties
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public Map<String, Object> launchArguments(Path program) {
          String programPath = program == null ? "" : program.toString();
          Path parent = program == null ? null : program.getParent();
          String fileDirectory = parent == null ? "." : parent.toString();
          Map<String, Object> resolved = new LinkedHashMap<>();
          for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : launchArguments.entrySet()) {
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            resolved.put(entry.getKey(), value instanceof String text
                ? text.replace("${program}", programPath).replace("${fileDir}", fileDirectory) : value);
          }
          return resolved;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the extra environment variables used to start the adapter.
         * @return the immutable environment map
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public Map<String, String> getEnvironment() {
          return environment;
        }
      
      }

      package io.simpleide.dap;
      
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.nio.file.Path;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Locale;
      
      import io.simpleide.language.config.LangPlatform;
      
      /**
       * Coordinates debug adapter discovery, installation and session startup.
       *
       * <p>
       * The manager resolves the adapter registered for the current operating system and
       * architecture, installs it on first use and then creates a {@link DapSession}. When the
       * platform has no adapter, or when the download fails, {@link #prepare()} throws
       * {@link DapUnavailableException} with a message suitable for the user; callers disable
       * the Debug action until the next attempt.
       *
       * <p>
       * Covered by {@code DapRegistryTest} and {@code DapManagerTest}.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      public final class DapManager {
      
        /**
         * Transport used by adapters hosted by a language server instead of a downloaded
         * process, such as the Java debug adapter inside the JDT language server.
         */
        public static final String JDTLS_TRANSPORT = "jdtls";
      
        private final DapRegistry registry;
      
        private final LangPlatform platform;
      
        /**
         * Creates a manager for a registry and platform.
         * @param registry adapter registry
         * @param platform platform used to select downloads
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public DapManager(DapRegistry registry, LangPlatform platform) {
          this.registry = registry;
          this.platform = platform;
        }
      
        /**
         * Creates a manager backed by the bundled registry and the detected platform.
         * @return the default manager
         * @throws DapUnavailableException when the bundled registry cannot be read
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static DapManager createDefault() throws DapUnavailableException {
          try {
            return new DapManager(DapRegistry.loadDefault(), LangPlatform.getCurrentPlatform());
          }
          catch (RuntimeException error) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Unable to read the debug adapter registry.", error);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns whether an adapter is registered for this platform.
         * @return {@code true} when debugging can be offered
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean isSupported() {
          return registry.supports(platform);
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns whether a program can be debugged on this platform.
         * @param program source file
         * @return {@code true} when an adapter is registered for the file language
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean supports(Path program) {
          String language = languageOf(program);
          return !language.isEmpty() && registry.supports(platform, language);
        }
      
        /**
         * Resolves the language identifier used to select a debug adapter.
         * @param program source file
         * @return the language identifier, or an empty string when the language is not
         * debuggable
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static String languageOf(Path program) {
          if (program == null || program.getFileName() == null) {
            return "";
          }
          String name = program.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
          int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
          String extension = dot < 0 ? "" : name.substring(dot + 1);
          return switch (extension) {
            case "js", "jsx", "mjs", "cjs", "jscript" -> "javascript";
            case "py", "pyi", "pyw", "py3" -> "python";
            case "go" -> "go";
            case "java", "jav" -> "java";
            default -> "";
          };
        }
      
        /**
         * Resolves and installs the adapter for this platform.
         * @return the installed adapter and its download entry
         * @throws DapUnavailableException when the platform is unsupported or installation
         * fails
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public PreparedAdapter prepare() throws DapUnavailableException {
          DapAdapter adapter = registry.findForPlatform(platform);
          if (adapter == null) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Debugging is not supported on " + platform.getDisplayName() + ".");
          }
          return prepare(adapter);
        }
      
        /**
         * Resolves and installs the adapter for a program language.
         * @param program source file
         * @return the installed adapter and its download entry
         * @throws DapUnavailableException when the language is unsupported or installation
         * fails
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public PreparedAdapter prepare(Path program) throws DapUnavailableException {
          String language = languageOf(program);
          if (language.isEmpty()) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Debugging is not supported for " + program.getFileName() + ".");
          }
          DapAdapter adapter = registry.findForPlatform(platform, language);
          if (adapter == null) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Debugging " + language + " is not supported on " + platform.getDisplayName() + ".");
          }
          if (JDTLS_TRANSPORT.equals(adapter.getTransport())) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Debugging " + language + " runs inside the language server, which has no download to install.");
          }
          return prepare(adapter);
        }
      
        private PreparedAdapter prepare(DapAdapter adapter) throws DapUnavailableException {
          DapDownload download = adapter.downloadFor(platform);
          if (download == null) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "No " + adapter.getName() + " download is registered for " + platform.getDisplayName() + ".");
          }
          try {
            Path directory = DapInstaller.install(adapter, download);
            return new PreparedAdapter(adapter, download, directory);
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Debug adapter installation was interrupted.", error);
          }
          catch (IOException | RuntimeException error) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Unable to download and install " + adapter.getName() + ": " + error.getMessage(), error);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts a debug session for a program.
         * @param program program to debug
         * @param breakpoints initial line breakpoints
         * @param listener listener for execution state changes
         * @return the started session
         * @throws DapUnavailableException when the adapter is unavailable or the session
         * cannot start
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public DapSession start(Path program, List<Integer> breakpoints, DapSession.Listener listener)
            throws DapUnavailableException {
          if (isLanguageServerDebug(program)) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Debugging " + languageOf(program) + " runs through the language server; use startJava.");
          }
          PreparedAdapter prepared = prepare(program);
          DapSession session = new DapSession(prepared.adapter(), prepared.installDirectory(), program, listener);
          try {
            session.start(breakpoints);
            return session;
          }
          catch (IOException error) {
            session.close();
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Unable to start " + prepared.adapter().getName() + ": " + error.getMessage(), error);
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            session.close();
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Debug adapter startup was interrupted.", error);
          }
          catch (RuntimeException error) {
            session.close();
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Unable to start " + prepared.adapter().getName() + ": " + error.getMessage(), error);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts a Java debug session through the JDT language server.
         *
         * <p>
         * The Java debug adapter is hosted by the language server, so no standalone adapter
         * is downloaded. The language server must already be initialized and the
         * {@code vscode.java.startDebugSession} command must be available.
         * @param program Java source file to debug
         * @param client language-server command client
         * @param breakpoints initial line breakpoints
         * @param listener listener for execution state changes
         * @return the started session
         * @throws DapUnavailableException when the language server cannot start a session
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public DapSession startJava(Path program, JavaDebugBridge.JavaDebugClient client, List<Integer> breakpoints,
            DapSession.Listener listener) throws DapUnavailableException {
          if (client == null) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException(
                "Java debugging requires the Java language server. Open the file and wait for it to connect.");
          }
          try {
            return JavaDebugBridge.start(client, program, breakpoints, listener);
          }
          catch (IOException error) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Unable to start Java debugging: " + error.getMessage(), error);
          }
          catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Java debug startup was interrupted.", error);
          }
          catch (RuntimeException error) {
            throw new DapUnavailableException("Unable to start Java debugging: " + error.getMessage(), error);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns whether a program is debugged through a language server rather than a
         * standalone adapter.
         * @param program source file
         * @return {@code true} when the resolved adapter uses the {@code jdtls} transport
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean isLanguageServerDebug(Path program) {
          String language = languageOf(program);
          if (language.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
          }
          DapAdapter adapter = registry.findForPlatform(platform, language);
          return adapter != null && JDTLS_TRANSPORT.equals(adapter.getTransport());
        }
      
        /**
         * Installed adapter ready to launch a session.
         *
         * @param adapter adapter definition
         * @param download platform download entry
         * @param installDirectory installation directory
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public record PreparedAdapter(DapAdapter adapter, DapDownload download, Path installDirectory) {
        }
      
        /**
         * Signals that debugging cannot start on this machine.
         *
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public static final class DapUnavailableException extends Exception {
      
          /**
           * Creates an unavailable exception with a user-facing message.
           * @param message explanation shown to the user
           * @author BrunoRNS
           * @since v1.1.0
           */
          public DapUnavailableException(String message) {
            super(message);
          }
      
          /**
           * Creates an unavailable exception with a user-facing message and cause.
           * @param message explanation shown to the user
           * @param cause underlying failure
           * @author BrunoRNS
           * @since v1.1.0
           */
          public DapUnavailableException(String message, Throwable cause) {
            super(message, cause);
          }
      
        }
      
      }

> _Reasoning_
> Key insight from delve source:
> 
> ```go
> // Reject all other requests if the target hasn't been launched
> if s.debugger == nil {
> 	r := request.(dap.RequestMessage).GetRequest()
> 	s.sendShowUserErrorResponse(*r, NoDebugIsRunning, "No debug session started", "Use launch or attach request first.")
> 	return
> }
> ```
> 
> So "No debug session started" is returned for any request sent before launch completes. In our flow we do launch() → awaitInitializedEvent() → sendBreakpoints. If launch hasn't completed, setBreakpoints gets "No debug session started". And delve sends `initialized` event... when? In delve, the launch request handling is asynchronous? Let's check `onLaunchRequest` — in delve, the launch request is handled in a goroutine? Actually in delve the launch request handling blocks until the debugger launched, and sends the `initialized` event... hmm. In VSCode's Go extension flow: initialize → (response) → launch → adapter sends `initialized` event → client sends setBreakpoints/configurationDone → launch response.
> 
> So delve sends `initialized` from within the launch handler after creating the debugger. So our awaitInitializedEvent should complete. But the log shows timeout of 90s and then "No debug session started". That means the initialized event was never received AND the setBreakpoints was rejected as no session. So the launch request must not have reached the server / been processed. Possibly the launch request was rejected earlier? Or maybe the launch request failed... Actually await(launchRequest) would throw the error.
> 
> Hmm, maybe the JSON-RPC message framing over TCP works but... Python/Go work? The user says Python/JS/Java debug work. Delve is TCP too (debugpy also TCP). So transport fine.
> 
> Wait — critical: delve sends `initialized` event; our `Client.initialized()` completes the future. But maybe LSP4J dispatches... fine.
> 
> So probably the real problem: delve never even got the launch request? Or launch request got error "invalid debug configuration"? No—the error we get is from setBreakpoints probably: "No debug session started". Which means the launch request was not yet processed (delve processes requests sequentially?) Actually in delve `server.go`, requests are handled in one goroutine? Let me read delve's serveDAPCodec / handleRequest. In delve, `Session.run` reads requests and handles `launch` in a goroutine? There was something about `s.mu`. And delay: launching a Go program requires building, which for a new module may take time... plus "program" is the .go file. `dlv dap` with mode debug and program pointing to a single `.go` file works ("dlv debug .go file" is supported since Go 1.16 — you can build a list of .go files).

> Hmm, but the 90s timeout suggests build hung? Actually delve sends `initialized` BEFORE building? Let's read actual delve server.go around onLaunchRequest to see when `initialized` event is sent.

    func (s *Session) isNoDebug() bool {
      s.mu.Lock()
      defer s.mu.Unlock()
      return s.noDebugProcess != nil
    }

    // onRestartRequest handles 'restart' request.
    // Capability 'supportsRestartRequest' is set to true in 'initialize' response.
    func (s *Session) onRestartRequest(request *dap.RestartRequest) {
      s.changeStateMu.Lock()
      defer s.changeStateMu.Unlock()
    
      // The response is just an acknowledgement, if we don't send it VSCode gets wedged
      s.send(&dap.RestartResponse{Response:
    *s.newResponse(request.Request)})
    
      // Cannot restart in noDebug mode
      if s.isNoDebug() {
        s.sendErrorResponse(request.Request, FailedToLaunch, "Cannot restart", "cannot restart in noDebug mode")
        return
      }
    
      if s.debugger == nil {
        s.sendErrorResponse(request.Request, FailedToLaunch, "Cannot restart: debugger is not running", "Debugger is not running")
        return
      }
    s.config.log.Debug("halting execution to restart")
      s.setHaltRequested(true)
      _, err := s.halt()
      if err != nil {
        var errProcessExited proc.ErrProcessExited
        if !errors.As(err, &errProcessExited) {
          s.sendErrorResponse(request.Request, FailedToLaunch, "Cannot restart", fmt.Sprintf("cannot restart process: %v", err))
          return
        }
      }
    // Cannot restart attached processes
      if s.debugger.AttachPid() != 0 {
        s.sendErrorResponse(request.Request, FailedToLaunch, "Cannot restart", "cannot restart process Delve did not create")
        return
      }
    
      var newArgs []string
      var resetArgs bool
      rebuild := true
    
      // Update launch/attach arguments if provided
      if len(request.Arguments) > 0 {
    var restartArgs struct {
          Arguments struct {
            Request string `json:"request"`
            LaunchConfig
            Rebuild *bool `json:"rebuild,omitempty"`
          }
        }
        err := json.Unmarshal(request.Arguments, &restartArgs)
        if err != nil {
          s.sendErrorResponse(request.Request, FailedToLaunch, "Cannot restart", "unable to unmarshal launch args")
          return
    }
        if restartArgs.Arguments.Request == "launch" {
          if restartArgs.Arguments.Rebuild != nil {
            rebuild = *restartArgs.Arguments.Rebuild
          }
          launchArgs := restartArgs.Arguments.LaunchConfig
          s.setLaunchAttachArgs(launchArgs.LaunchAttachCommonConfig)
          // Extract new program arguments if provided
          if launchArgs.Args != nil {
    newArgs = launchArgs.Args
            resetArgs = true
          }
        }
      }
    
      validBefore := true
      if _, err := s.debugger.State(false); err != nil {
        validBefore = false
      }
    
      // TODO(deparker) handle args from the launch regarding re-recording.
      discardedBreakpoints, err := s.debugger.Restart(false, "", resetArgs, newArgs, [3]string{}, rebuild)
      if err
    != nil {
        s.sendErrorResponse(request.Request, FailedToLaunch, "Failed to restart", err.Error())
        if state, err := s.debugger.State(false); validBefore && err != nil {
          if processExited(state, err) {
            s.sendExitedEvent(state, err)
          }
          s.send(&dap.TerminatedEvent{Event: *s.newEvent("terminated")})
        }
        return
      }
    s.config.log.Infof("Restart completed. Discarded breakpoints: %v", discardedBreakpoints)
    
      s.send(&dap.InitializedEvent{Event: *s.newEvent("initialized")})
    }

      package io.simpleide.language.io;
      
      import java.util.Objects;
      import java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue;
      import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
      import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
      import java.util.function.Consumer;
      
      import org.slf4j.Logger;
      import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
      
      import io.simpleide.language.io.holder.OutputHolder;
      
      /**
       * Thread-safe queue of lines published by a running language process.
       *
       * <p>
       * The language runner enqueues every line read from the process, including merged
       * standard error, so callers can consume program output without blocking the process. Use
       * {@link #getInstance()} to access the process-wide queue.
       *
       * <p>
       * Lines carry an {@link OutputType}. Listeners registered with
       * {@link #addListener(Consumer)} receive every line together with its type; they are
       * intended for UI components such as the terminal I/O tab and must return quickly because
       * they run on the publishing thread.
       *
       * <p>
       * Covered by {@code IOConcurrencyTest} and {@code IOOutputListenerTest}.
       *
       * @see <a href=
       * "https://github.com/BrunoRNS/SIMPLE-IDE/blob/main/docs/api/languages.md">docs/api/languages.md</a>
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      public class Output {
      
        /**
         * Marker published when a running program is waiting for standard input.
         */
        public static final String WAITING_FOR_STDIN = "{WAITING FOR STDIN}";
      
        /**
         * Marker published when a debug session completed the protocol handshake.
         */
        public static final String INITIALIZED = "{INITIALIZED}";
      
        /**
         * Marker published when a debug session finished.
         */
        public static final String FINISHED = "{FINISHED}";
      
        private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Output.class);
      
        private final BlockingQueue<String> queue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>();
      
        private final CopyOnWriteArrayList<Consumer<OutputLine>> listeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
        /**
         * Enqueues a line read from the running process.
         * @param text the line to publish, ignored when {@code null}
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void set(String text) {
          publish(OutputType.OUTPUT, text);
        }
      
        /**
         * Publishes a typed line to every registered listener. Only ordinary program output
         * is also placed in the legacy string queue consumed by {@link #get(long)}.
         * @param type classification of the line, defaults to {@link OutputType#OUTPUT} when
         * {@code null}
         * @param text the line to publish, ignored when {@code null}
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void publish(OutputType type, String text) {
          if (text == null) {
            return;
          }
          OutputType effectiveType = type == null ? OutputType.OUTPUT : type;
          if (effectiveType == OutputType.OUTPUT) {
            queue.offer(text);
          }
          OutputLine line = new OutputLine(effectiveType, text);
          for (Consumer<OutputLine> listener : listeners) {
            try {
              listener.accept(line);
            }
            catch (RuntimeException error) {
              LOGGER.warn("An output listener failed to handle a published line.", error);
            }
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Waits for the next line published by the process.
         * @param waitSeconds the maximum time to wait, in seconds
         * @return the next line, or {@code null} when the timeout expires
         * @throws InterruptedException if the calling thread is interrupted while waiting
         */
        public String get(long waitSeconds) throws InterruptedException {
          return queue.poll(waitSeconds, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }
      
        /**
         * Registers a listener that receives every published line with its type.
         * @param listener listener to register, ignored when {@code null}
         * @return a handle that removes the listener when closed
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public AutoCloseable addListener(Consumer<OutputLine> listener) {
          if (listener == null) {
            return () -> {
            };
          }
          listeners.add(listener);
          return () -> listeners.remove(listener);
        }
      
        /**
         * Removes a previously registered listener.
         * @param listener listener to remove, ignored when {@code null}
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void removeListener(Consumer<OutputLine> listener) {
          if (listener != null) {
            listeners.remove(listener);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the process-wide output queue.
         * @return the shared {@link Output} instance
         */
        public static Output getInstance() {
          return OutputHolder.INSTANCE;
        }
      
        /**
         * One typed line published by a language process.
         *
         * @param type classification of the line
         * @param text line text without the type prefix
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public record OutputLine(OutputType type, String text) {
      
          /**
           * Creates a validated output line.
           * @param type classification of the line, defaults to {@link OutputType#OUTPUT}
           * @param text line text
           * @author BrunoRNS
           * @since v1.1.0
           */
          public OutputLine {
            Objects.requireNonNull(type, "type");
            Objects.requireNonNull(text, "text");
          }
      
        }
      
      }

      package io.simpleide.ui.io;
      
      import java.awt.BorderLayout;
      import java.awt.Color;
      import java.awt.Dimension;
      import java.awt.Font;
      import java.awt.GridLayout;
      import java.util.Objects;
      import java.util.function.Consumer;
      
      import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
      import javax.swing.JButton;
      import javax.swing.JLabel;
      import javax.swing.JPanel;
      import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
      import javax.swing.JSplitPane;
      import javax.swing.JTextArea;
      import javax.swing.JTextPane;
      import javax.swing.KeyStroke;
      import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
      import javax.swing.UIManager;
      import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
      import javax.swing.text.SimpleAttributeSet;
      import javax.swing.text.StyleConstants;
      import javax.swing.text.StyledDocument;
      
      import org.slf4j.Logger;
      import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
      
      import io.simpleide.dap.DapSession;
      import io.simpleide.language.AbstractLanguage;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.Output;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.OutputType;
      import io.simpleide.thread.nodes.edt.listeners.ActionNode;
      import io.simpleide.ui.ThemeColors;
      
      /**
       * Terminal-area tab with program input, coloured program output and debug controls.
       *
       * <p>
       * The upper text area sends every submitted line through the shared
       * {@link io.simpleide.language.io.Input} queue while the program runs. The lower text
       * pane displays output events from the shared {@link Output} queue, prefixing each line
       * with {@code [OUTPUT]}, {@code [ERROR]} or {@code [DEBUG]} and colouring it with the
       * active theme. When a debug session is running, the panel also shows continue, pause,
       * step and stop buttons that drive the {@link DapSession}.
       *
       * <p>
       * Covered by {@code IOPanelTest}.
       *
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      public final class IOPanel extends JPanel {
      
        private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(IOPanel.class);
      
        private final JTextArea inputArea = new JTextArea();
      
        private final JTextPane outputPane = new JTextPane();
      
        private final JPanel debugControls = new JPanel(new GridLayout(1, 0, 6, 0));
      
        private final JButton continueButton = controlButton("Continue", DapSession::resume);
      
        private final JButton pauseButton = controlButton("Pause", DapSession::pause);
      
        private final JButton stepOverButton = controlButton("Step Over", DapSession::stepOver);
      
        private final JButton stepIntoButton = controlButton("Step Into", DapSession::stepInto);
      
        private final JButton stepOutButton = controlButton("Step Out", DapSession::stepOut);
      
        private final JButton stopButton = controlButton("Stop", DapSession::close);
      
        private InputForwarder forwarder;
      
        private final Consumer<Output.OutputLine> outputListener = this::append;
      
        private AbstractLanguage language;
      
        private Runnable executionListener;
      
        private DapSession session;
      
        private boolean debugMode;
      
        private boolean outputSubscribed;
      
        private Consumer<String> inputHistoryListener = ignored -> {
        };
      
        /**
         * Creates an empty I/O tab with the application theme.
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public IOPanel() {
          super(new BorderLayout(0, 6));
          setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(8, 10, 8, 10));
      
          JSplitPane split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.VERTICAL_SPLIT, createInputSection(), createOutputSection());
          split.setResizeWeight(0.32);
          split.setContinuousLayout(true);
          split.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
          add(split, BorderLayout.CENTER);
          add(createDebugControls(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
      
          inputArea.getInputMap().put(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ENTER"), "simpleide.io.submit");
          inputArea.getActionMap().put("simpleide.io.submit", new javax.swing.AbstractAction() {
            @Override
            public void actionPerformed(java.awt.event.ActionEvent event) {
              submitInput();
            }
          });
          applyTheme();
          setDebugMode(false);
        }
      
        private JPanel createInputSection() {
          JPanel section = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 4));
          section.setOpaque(false);
          section.add(sectionTitle("INPUT"), BorderLayout.NORTH);
      
          inputArea.setLineWrap(true);
          inputArea.setWrapStyleWord(true);
          inputArea.setRows(4);
          inputArea.setToolTipText("Type program input and press Enter to send it");
          inputArea.getAccessibleContext().setAccessibleName("Program input");
          JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(inputArea);
          scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(ThemeColors.ui("Component.borderColor", "Separator.foreground"),
              1, true));
          section.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
          return section;
        }
      
        private JPanel createOutputSection() {
          JPanel section = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 4));
          section.setOpaque(false);
          section.add(sectionTitle("OUTPUT"), BorderLayout.NORTH);
      
          outputPane.setEditable(false);
          outputPane.setFocusable(false);
          outputPane.setToolTipText("Program output");
          outputPane.getAccessibleContext().setAccessibleName("Program output");
          JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(outputPane);
          scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(ThemeColors.ui("Component.borderColor", "Separator.foreground"),
              1, true));
          section.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
          return section;
        }
      
        private JPanel createDebugControls() {
          debugControls.setOpaque(false);
          debugControls.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(2, 0, 0, 0));
          debugControls.add(continueButton);
          debugControls.add(pauseButton);
          debugControls.add(stepOverButton);
          debugControls.add(stepIntoButton);
          debugControls.add(stepOutButton);
          debugControls.add(stopButton);
          debugControls.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(0, 32));
          return debugControls;
        }
      
        private JLabel sectionTitle(String text) {
          JLabel title = new JLabel(text);
          Font font = UIManager.getFont("Label.font");
          if (font != null) {
            title.setFont(font.deriveFont(Font.BOLD, Math.max(10f, font.getSize2D() - 1f)));
          }
          return title;
        }
      
        private JButton controlButton(String label, Consumer<DapSession> action) {
          JButton button = new JButton(label);
          button.addActionListener(new ActionNode(event -> {
            DapSession active = session;
            if (active != null) {
              action.accept(active);
            }
          }));
          return button;
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts a plain run: clears the output and forwards program output and input.
         * @param runningLanguage language process that will own the input forwarder
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void beginRun(AbstractLanguage runningLanguage) {
          beginExecution(runningLanguage, false);
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts a debug run: clears the output, forwards output and input and shows the
         * debug controls.
         * @param runningLanguage language process that will own the input forwarder, may be
         * {@code null} when the adapter launches the program itself
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void beginDebug(AbstractLanguage runningLanguage) {
          beginExecution(runningLanguage, true);
        }
      
        private void beginExecution(AbstractLanguage runningLanguage, boolean debug) {
          finishExecution();
          clearOutput();
          debugMode = debug;
          language = runningLanguage;
          forwarder = new InputForwarder();
          // Consome o conteudo ja digitado na area de input como stdin inicial
          // do programa. O usuario ainda pode digitar mais inputs e enviar com Enter.
          String initialInput = inputArea.getText();
          if (initialInput != null && !initialInput.isBlank()) {
            forwarder.submit(initialInput);
            inputArea.setText("");
          }
          Output.getInstance().addListener(outputListener);
          outputSubscribed = true;
          if (language != null) {
            executionListener = () -> {
              if (SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()) {
                finishExecution();
              }
              else {
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::finishExecution);
              }
            };
            language.addExecutionListener(executionListener);
          }
          setDebugMode(debug);
          inputArea.requestFocusInWindow();
        }
      
        /**
         * Releases the input forwarder and output subscription after the program ends.
         *
         * <p>
         * Calling the method more than once is safe; it is registered as the language
         * execution listener and is also called when a new run starts.
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void finishExecution() {
          InputForwarder activeForwarder = forwarder;
          forwarder = null;
          if (activeForwarder != null) {
            activeForwarder.close();
          }
          if (outputSubscribed) {
            Output.getInstance().removeListener(outputListener);
            outputSubscribed = false;
          }
          if (language != null && executionListener != null) {
            language.removeExecutionListener(executionListener);
          }
          language = null;
          executionListener = null;
          DapSession activeSession = session;
          session = null;
          if (activeSession != null) {
            activeSession.close();
          }
          if (debugMode) {
            setDebugMode(false);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Binds the debug session used by the control buttons.
         * @param debugSession active debug session, or {@code null} to clear it
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void setSession(DapSession debugSession) {
          this.session = debugSession;
        }
      
        /**
         * Shows or hides the debug control buttons.
         * @param debug {@code true} for debug mode
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void setDebugMode(boolean debug) {
          debugMode = debug;
          debugControls.setVisible(debug);
          revalidate();
          repaint();
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns whether the panel is currently in debug mode.
         * @return {@code true} when the debug controls are expected
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean isDebugMode() {
          return debugMode;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns whether an execution is currently forwarding input and output.
         * @return {@code true} while a run or debug session is active
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean isExecutionActive() {
          return forwarder != null;
        }
      
        /**
         * Sends the current input area content to the running process.
         * @return {@code true} when at least one line was queued
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public boolean submitInput() {
          InputForwarder active = forwarder;
          if (active == null) {
            return false;
          }
          String text = inputArea.getText();
          boolean submitted = active.submit(text);
          if (submitted) {
            inputArea.setText("");
            inputHistoryListener.accept(text.strip());
          }
          return submitted;
        }
      
        /**
         * Registers a listener notified with the text of every submitted input.
         * @param listener listener to invoke, or {@code null} to clear it
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void setInputHistoryListener(Consumer<String> listener) {
          inputHistoryListener = listener == null ? ignored -> {
          } : listener;
        }
      
        /**
         * Appends a typed output line to the pane.
         * @param line line published by the language process or debug adapter
         */
        private void append(Output.OutputLine line) {
          appendLine(line.type(), line.text());
        }
      
        /**
         * Appends a typed output line to the pane, colouring it with the active theme.
         * @param type classification of the line
         * @param text line text
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void appendLine(OutputType type, String text) {
          Objects.requireNonNull(type, "type");
          if (text == null) {
            return;
          }
          Runnable append = () -> {
            StyledDocument document = outputPane.getStyledDocument();
            try {
              document.insertString(document.getLength(), "[" + type + "] " + text + System.lineSeparator(),
                  styleFor(type));
              outputPane.setCaretPosition(document.getLength());
            }
            catch (BadLocationException error) {
              LOGGER.warn("Unable to append output to the I/O tab.", error);
            }
          };
          if (SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()) {
            append.run();
          }
          else {
            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(append);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Removes every line from the output pane.
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void clearOutput() {
          outputPane.setText("");
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the output text currently displayed.
         * @return the plain output text
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getOutputText() {
          return outputPane.getText();
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the input text currently typed.
         * @return the input text
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public String getInputText() {
          return inputArea.getText();
        }
      
        /**

        }

        }

         * Refreshes the panel colors and output styles after a theme change.

         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        @Override
        public void updateUI() {
          super.updateUI();
          if (inputArea != null) {
            applyTheme();
            refreshOutputStyles();
          }
        }
      
        private SimpleAttributeSet styleFor(OutputType type) {
          SimpleAttributeSet style = new SimpleAttributeSet();
          Color color = switch (type) {
            case ERROR -> ThemeColors.ui("Log.errorForeground", "Component.error.focusedBorderColor");
            case DEBUG -> ThemeColors.ui("Log.debugForeground", "Component.focusColor");
            case OUTPUT -> null;
          };
          if (color != null) {
            StyleConstants.setForeground(style, color);
          }
          return style;
        }
      
        private void refreshOutputStyles() {
          StyledDocument document = outputPane.getStyledDocument();
          if (document.getLength() == 0) {
            return;
          }
          try {
            String text = document.getText(0, document.getLength());
            document.remove(0, document.getLength());
            for (String line : text.split("(?<=\\n)", -1)) {
              OutputType type = line.startsWith("[ERROR] ") ? OutputType.ERROR
                  : line.startsWith("[DEBUG] ") ? OutputType.DEBUG : OutputType.OUTPUT;
              document.insertString(document.getLength(), line, styleFor(type));
            }
          }
          catch (BadLocationException ignored) {
            LOGGER.warn("Unable to refresh output colors after a theme change.", ignored);
          }
        }
      
        private void applyTheme() {
          Color background = ThemeColors.ui("TextArea.background", "EditorPane.background", "Panel.background");
          Color foreground = ThemeColors.ui("TextArea.foreground", "EditorPane.foreground", "Label.foreground");
          Font font = UIManager.getFont("TextArea.font");
          if (background != null) {
            inputArea.setBackground(background);
            outputPane.setBackground(background);
          }
          if (foreground != null) {
            inputArea.setForeground(ThemeColors.readable(foreground, background));
            outputPane.setForeground(ThemeColors.readable(foreground, background));
          }
          if (font != null) {
            Font mono = new Font(Font.MONOSPACED, font.getStyle(), font.getSize());
            inputArea.setFont(mono);
            outputPane.setFont(mono);
          }
          inputArea.setCaretColor(foreground);
          inputArea.setSelectionColor(ThemeColors.ui("TextArea.selectionBackground", "EditorPane.selectionBackground"));
          inputArea
            .setSelectedTextColor(ThemeColors.ui("TextArea.selectionForeground", "EditorPane.selectionForeground"));
          inputArea.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(6, 8, 6, 8));
        }
      
      }

> _Reasoning_
> The outputPane is non-editable and non-focusable: `setFocusable(false)` prevents selection? Actually selection works even if not focusable? With JTextPane, setEditable(false) still allows selecting with mouse. But focusable false means keyboard Ctrl+C won't reach it. The user wants Ctrl+C copy. Fix: make output pane focusable, editable false, add Ctrl+C copy binding (and maybe Ctrl+A select all), and disable focus stealing issues. Also default copy action for JTextPane when not editable: JTextPane's "copy" action uses DefaultEditorKit.DefaultCopyAction which requires selection — should work when it has focus and a selection.
> 
> So: remove setFocusable(false), set requestFocusEnabled, add keybinding CTRL+C to copy, CTRL+A select all, and also add a context menu "Copy". Minimal: focusable + Ctrl+C/Ctrl+A bindings.
> 
> Also the run/stop button: "O Run padrão tenque ter um botão de Stop pra parar uma linguagem em execução no modo sem debug." So when running without debug, need a Stop button. Where's the Run control? Look at MainFrame / toolbar. `setDebugMode(false)` hides debug controls; stopButton is in debugControls so hidden in run mode. Need Stop visible in run mode (without Continue/Pause/Step). Need a way to kill the running language process. Let's inspect AbstractLanguage to see if there's a stop/kill method.

      package io.simpleide.language;
      
      import java.io.BufferedWriter;
      import java.io.IOException;
      import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
      import java.util.List;
      import java.util.Scanner;
      import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
      import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
      import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
      import java.util.function.Consumer;
      
      import org.slf4j.Logger;
      import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
      
      import io.simpleide.language.exceptions.ProcessAlreadyExistsException;
      import io.simpleide.language.exceptions.ProcessFatalException;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.Output;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.OutputType;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.holder.InputHolder;
      import io.simpleide.thread.ThreadMaster;
      import io.simpleide.thread.nodes.runnable.RunnableNode;
      
      /**
       * Base class for executable languages in Simple IDE.
       *
       * <p>
       * A language owns one or more {@link ProcessBuilder} steps and runs them in order. The
       * run stops at the first failed step, except that the final step always reaches the exit
       * handler. Output from the active process is published line by line to {@link Output},
       * while lines queued in {@link InputHolder} are forwarded to the process standard input
       * on a background {@link RunnableNode}.
       *
       * <p>
       * Subclasses configure {@link #pb} or {@link #processSteps} and may override
       * {@link #handleExit(Process)} or {@link #onExecutionFinished()} to customise the
       * lifecycle. See docs/api/languages.md for usage examples.
       *
       * <p>
       * Covered by {@code AbstractLanguageTest}.
       *
       * @see <a href=
       * "https://github.com/BrunoRNS/SIMPLE-IDE/blob/main/docs/api/languages.md">docs/api/languages.md</a>
       * @author BrunoRNS
       * @since v1.1.0
       */
      public abstract class AbstractLanguage implements Runnable {
      
        private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractLanguage.class);
      
        protected ProcessBuilder pb;
      
        protected List<ProcessBuilder> processSteps = List.of();
      
        protected volatile Process p;
      
        protected volatile boolean stopped = false;
      
        private volatile RunnableNode inputForwarder;
      
        private final List<Runnable> executionListeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
      
        private final AtomicBoolean executionFinishedNotified = new AtomicBoolean();
      
        protected String langFriendly = null;
      
        protected String langConstant = null;
      
        /**
         * Returns the human-readable language name configured by the subclass.
         * @return the friendly language name, or {@code null} when not configured
         */
        public String getLangFriendly() {
          return this.langFriendly;
        }
      
        /**
         * Returns the syntax constant used to highlight files of this language.
         * @return the language constant, or {@code null} when not configured
         */
        public String getLangConstant() {
          return this.langConstant;
        }
      
        /**
         * Executes the configured process pipeline and publishes its output.
         * @throws ProcessAlreadyExistsException if this language already has a live process
         * @throws ProcessFatalException if the process cannot start, fails, or the wait is
         * interrupted
         */
        @Override
        public void run() {
          synchronized (this) {
            if (this.p != null && this.p.isAlive()) {
              throw new ProcessAlreadyExistsException("Impossible to Run the script while still running another",
                  this.p);
            }
          }
      
          stopped = false;
          executionFinishedNotified.set(false);
          List<ProcessBuilder> builders = getProcessBuilders();
          if (builders.isEmpty()) {
            String message = "Cannot run language process because its command was not configured.";
            LOGGER.error("[IDE] {}", message);
            Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.ERROR, message);
            notifyExecutionFinished();
            return;
          }
          try {
            for (int index = 0; index < builders.size(); index++) {
              Process process = builders.get(index).redirectErrorStream(true).start();
              p = process;
              if (index == builders.size() - 1) {
                startInputForwarder(process);
              }
      
              try (Scanner scanner = new Scanner(process.getInputStream())) {
                while (scanner.hasNextLine()) {
                  String line = scanner.nextLine();
                  Output.getInstance().set(line);
                  LOGGER.info("[OUTPUT] {}", line);
                }
                IOException streamFailure = scanner.ioException();
                if (streamFailure != null) {
                  throw streamFailure;
                }
              }
      
              int exitCode = process.waitFor();
              if (exitCode != 0 || index == builders.size() - 1) {
                getHandler().accept(process);
                return;
              }
      
              p = null;
            }
          }
          catch (IOException e) {
            stopCurrentProcess();
            Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.ERROR, "Process did not finish successfully at startup.");
            notifyExecutionFinished();
            throw new ProcessFatalException("Process Did not Finish Successfully at startup", e);
          }
          catch (InterruptedException e) {
            stopCurrentProcess();
            Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.ERROR, "Interrupted while waiting for the language process.");
            notifyExecutionFinished();
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new ProcessFatalException("Interrupted while waiting for the language process.", new IOException(e));
          }
        }
      
        protected List<ProcessBuilder> getProcessBuilders() {
          if (!processSteps.isEmpty()) {
            return processSteps;
          }
          return pb == null ? List.of() : List.of(pb);
        }
      
        private void stopCurrentProcess() {
          Process process = p;
          if (process != null && process.isAlive()) {
            process.destroyForcibly();
          }
          p = null;
          stopped = false;
        }
      
        private void startInputForwarder(Process process) {
          RunnableNode forwarder = new RunnableNode(() -> {
            boolean waitingForStdin = false;
            try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(process.getOutputStream()))) {
              while (process.isAlive()) {
                String line = InputHolder.INSTANCE.get(1);
                if (line != null) {
                  writer.write(line);
                  writer.newLine();
                  writer.flush();
                  waitingForStdin = false;
                }
                else if (!waitingForStdin && process.isAlive()) {
                  waitingForStdin = true;
                  Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.OUTPUT, Output.WAITING_FOR_STDIN);
                }
              }
            }
            catch (InterruptedException e) {
              Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
            catch (IOException e) {
              if (process.isAlive()) {
                LOGGER.debug("[IDE] Could not forward input to the language process.", e);
              }
            }
          });
          inputForwarder = forwarder;
          ThreadMaster threadMaster = ThreadMaster.getInstance();
          threadMaster.initialize();
          threadMaster.register(forwarder);
        }
      
        /**
         * Registers this language with the shared thread manager and starts it
         * asynchronously.
         * @return the runnable node that tracks the managed execution
         */
        public final RunnableNode startManaged() {
          ThreadMaster threadMaster = ThreadMaster.getInstance();
          threadMaster.initialize();
          RunnableNode node = new RunnableNode(this);
          threadMaster.register(node);
          return node;
        }
      
        protected Consumer<Process> getHandler() {
          return new InternalExitHandler();
        }
      
        /**
         * Adapter that forwards process completion to
         * {@link AbstractLanguage#handleExit(Process)}.
         *
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.0.0beta
         */
        protected final class InternalExitHandler implements Consumer<Process> {
      
          @Override
          public final void accept(Process t) {
            handleExit(t);
          }
      
        }
      
        protected void handleExit(Process t) {
          try {
            int exitCode = t.exitValue();
      
            if (exitCode != 0) {
              if (stopped) {
                LOGGER.info("[IDE] Process manually interrupted by the user.");
                Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.DEBUG, "Process interrupted by the user.");
                return;
              }
              LOGGER.error("[OUTPUT] RUNTIME ERROR: {}", exitCode);
              LOGGER.error("[Runtime Error] The developer's program broke with code: {}", exitCode);
              Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.ERROR, "RUNTIME ERROR: " + exitCode);
            }
            else {
              LOGGER.info("[IDE] Process completed successfully.");
              Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.DEBUG, "Process completed successfully.");
            }
          }
          finally {
            RunnableNode forwarder = inputForwarder;
            inputForwarder = null;
            if (forwarder != null) {
              ThreadMaster.getInstance().removeNodeCascade(forwarder);
            }
            this.p = null;
            this.stopped = false;
            try {
              onExecutionFinished();
            }
            finally {
              notifyExecutionFinished();
            }
          }
        }
      
        private void notifyExecutionFinished() {
          if (!executionFinishedNotified.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
          }
          for (Runnable listener : executionListeners) {
            try {
              listener.run();
            }
            catch (RuntimeException error) {
              LOGGER.warn("[IDE] An execution listener failed while finishing the language process.", error);
            }
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Registers a listener invoked once when the current execution finishes.
         *
         * <p>
         * The listener runs on the language worker thread after the process exits or fails to
         * start. It is used by the I/O tab to release its input forwarder and to restore the
         * execution controls. Registering the same listener more than once is allowed; it is
         * called once per registration.
         * @param listener listener to invoke, ignored when {@code null}
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void addExecutionListener(Runnable listener) {
          if (listener != null) {
            executionListeners.add(listener);
          }
        }
      
        /**
         * Removes a previously registered execution listener.
         * @param listener listener to remove, ignored when {@code null}
         * @author BrunoRNS
         * @since v1.1.0
         */
        public void removeExecutionListener(Runnable listener) {
          if (listener != null) {
            executionListeners.remove(listener);
          }
        }
      
        protected void onExecutionFinished() {
        }
      
        /**
         * Forcibly stops the current process and waits briefly for it to terminate.
         * @throws ProcessFatalException if the process does not exit within three seconds
         */
        public void forceStop() throws ProcessFatalException {
          Process process = this.p;
          if (process == null || !process.isAlive()) {
            return;
          }
      
          this.stopped = true;
          process.destroyForcibly();
      
          try {
            boolean killed = process.waitFor(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if (!killed) {
              throw new ProcessFatalException("The process refused to die within 3 seconds.", process);
            }
          }
          catch (InterruptedException e) {
            LOGGER.debug("[Debug] The interrupt thread was itself interrupted.", e);
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
          }
        }
      
      }

        private void handleWindowClosed(@SuppressWarnings("unused") WindowEvent event) {
          try {
            detachBreakpointListener();

        private void installKeybindings() {
          Map<IdeAction, Runnable> actions = new EnumMap<>(IdeAction.class);
          actions.put(IdeAction.NEW_FILE, this::createNewFile);
          actions.put(IdeAction.OPEN_FOLDER, this::openFolder);
          actions.put(IdeAction.CLOSE_FOLDER, this::closeFolder);
          actions.put(IdeAction.CLOSE_EDITOR, () -> editorManager.closeSelectedTab());
          actions.put(IdeAction.CLOSE_ALL_EDITORS, () -> editorManager.closeAllEditors());
          actions.put(IdeAction.SAVE_ALL, () -> editorManager.saveAllEditors());
          actions.put(IdeAction.TOGGLE_SIDEBAR, this::toggleSidebar);
          actions.put(IdeAction.WORKSPACE_SEARCH, () -> showSidebarView(SidebarView.SEARCH));
          actions.put(IdeAction.OPEN_SETTINGS, () -> showSidebarView(SidebarView.SETTINGS));
          actions.put(IdeAction.RUN, this::runProgram);
          if (debugAvailable) {
            actions.put(IdeAction.DEBUG, this::debugProgram);
          }
          keybindingManager.install(getRootPane(), actions);
        }
      
        private void configureDebugAvailability() {
          try {
            dapManager = DapManager.createDefault();
            debugAvailable = dapManager.isSupported();
          }
          catch (DapManager.DapUnavailableException error) {
            dapManager = null;
            debugAvailable = false;
            logger.warn("Debugging is unavailable: {}", error.getMessage());
          }
        }
      
        private void applyDebugAvailability() {
          if (getJMenuBar() instanceof IdeMenuBar menuBar) {
            menuBar.setDebugEnabled(debugAvailable);
          }
          if (keybindingManager != null) {
            installKeybindings();
          }
        }
      
        private void runProgram() {
          if (ioPanel.isExecutionActive()) {
            showExecutionMessage("A program is already running. Stop it before starting another run.");
            return;
          }
          EditorTab tab = editorManager.getSelectedEditorTab();
          if (tab == null || tab.getEditor() == null) {
            showExecutionMessage("Open a source file before running a program.");
            return;
          }
          if (!saveBeforeExecution(tab)) {
            return;
          }
          outputTabs.setSelectedComponent(ioPanel);
          try {
            AbstractLanguage language = Languages.create(tab.getFile().getPath());
            ioPanel.beginRun(language);
            language.startManaged();
          }
          catch (RuntimeException error) {
            ioPanel.finishExecution();
            String message = "Unable to run " + tab.getFile().getName() + ": " + error.getMessage();
            ioPanel.appendLine(OutputType.ERROR, message);
            logger.error("Unable to run {}.", tab.getFile().getPath(), error);
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this, message, "Run failed", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
          }
        }
      
        private void debugProgram() {
          if (!debugAvailable || dapManager == null) {
            showExecutionMessage("Debugging is not available: no compatible debug adapter is installed.");
            return;
          }
          if (ioPanel.isExecutionActive()) {
            showExecutionMessage("A program is already running. Stop it before starting a debug session.");
            return;
          }
          EditorTab tab = editorManager.getSelectedEditorTab();
          if (tab == null || tab.getEditor() == null) {
            showExecutionMessage("Open a source file before starting a debug session.");
            return;
          }
          if (!saveBeforeExecution(tab)) {
            return;
          }
          Path program = tab.getFile().getPath();
          if (!dapManager.supports(program)) {
            showExecutionMessage("Debugging is not supported for " + tab.getFile().getName()
                + ". Open a Java, JavaScript, Python or Go file to debug.");
            return;
          }
          outputTabs.setSelectedComponent(ioPanel);
          ioPanel.beginDebug(null);
          List<Integer> breakpoints = tab.getBreakpoints();
          attachBreakpointListener(tab, program);
          DapSession.Listener listener = new DapSession.Listener() {
            @Override
            public void onTerminated() {
              SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
                dapSession = null;
                detachBreakpointListener();
                ioPanel.finishExecution();
              });
            }
          };
          RunnableNode startNode = new RunnableNode(() -> {
            try {
              DapSession session = startDebugSession(tab, program, breakpoints, listener);
              dapSession = session;
              session.setBreakpoints(program, tab.getBreakpoints());
              SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> ioPanel.setSession(session));
            }
            catch (DapManager.DapUnavailableException error) {
              SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> handleDebugFailure(error.getMessage()));
            }
            catch (InterruptedException error) {
              Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
              SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> handleDebugFailure("Debug startup was interrupted."));
            }
            catch (RuntimeException error) {
              SwingUtilities
                .invokeLater(() -> handleDebugFailure("Unable to start the debug session: " + error.getMessage()));
            }
          });
          ThreadMaster.getInstance().register(startNode);
        }
      
        /**
         * Starts the debug session for a program, using the JDT language server for Java and
         * a standalone adapter for the other languages.
         */
        private DapSession startDebugSession(EditorTab tab, Path program, List<Integer> breakpoints,
            DapSession.Listener listener) throws DapManager.DapUnavailableException, InterruptedException {
          if (!dapManager.isLanguageServerDebug(program)) {
            return dapManager.start(program, breakpoints, listener);
          }
          LspClient client = tab.getLanguageServer();
          if (client == null) {
            try {
              client = editorManager.connectLanguageServer(tab.getDocument())
                .get(30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            }
            catch (java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException | java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException error) {
              throw new DapManager.DapUnavailableException(
                  "Unable to reach the Java language server: " + error.getMessage(), error);
            }
          }
          LspClient activeClient = client;
          JavaDebugBridge.JavaDebugClient bridgeClient = (command, arguments) -> activeClient.executeCommand(command,
              arguments);
          return dapManager.startJava(program, bridgeClient, breakpoints, listener);
        }
      
        private void handleDebugFailure(String message) {
          dapSession = null;
          detachBreakpointListener();
          ioPanel.finishExecution();
          String explanation = message == null || message.isBlank()
              ? "Debugging is not available: the debug adapter could not be installed." : message;

> But should we silently disable a version check? Alternative: surface the error clearly and let it be — that fails the user's requirement ("Go debug must work"). I'll disable the check and document it, since delve's check is conservative (delve generally supports debugging several Go versions back for a program's *binary*; the min version relates to the Go toolchain used to build the debuggee).
> 
> Hmm wait, actually the check is about the Go version that built the *target binary*, because delicate symbol table formats. Practically, delve 1.27 debugging a Go 1.22-built binary worked here.
> 
> Also improve: remove `--accept-multiclient` (delve dap warns it's unsupported).
> 
> 2. Fail fast: DapSession should error out when the launch request fails instead of waiting 90s and reporting "No debug session started". Implement: pass the launch future into awaitInitializedEvent, and wait on whichever completes first; if launch fails, throw IOException with the adapter message.
> 
> B) Copyable output: IOPanel outputPane — remove setFocusable(false), add Ctrl+C / Ctrl+A key bindings and a popup menu with Copy / Select All.
> 
> C) Stop button in plain run mode: IOPanel — show a Stop button when plain run active that calls `language.forceStop()`. Keep debug controls as-is. Implementation: instead of hiding `debugControls` entirely in run mode, show only the stop button? Simplest: separate `runControls` panel with a Stop button, visible during run mode. But the panel's layout puts debugControls in SOUTH. Let me restructure: keep debugControls for debug, and add runControls panel (with Stop) also in SOUTH — only one visible at a time.
> 
> Where to place runControls? Use a container panel holding both. Simpler: add the stop button into debugControls? No—debug shows stop too. In run mode show only Stop, hiding other buttons. That's minimal: on setDebugMode(false) with an active run... but setDebugMode(false) is called at construction and on finish, where nothing runs.
> 
> Design: add field `runControls` JPanel with a Stop button that calls `language.forceStop()` on EDT-safe thread. In beginExecution: if debug -> show debugControls; else show runControls. In finishExecution -> hide both.
> 
> Stop action: `AbstractLanguage active = language; if (active != null) active.forceStop();` — forceStop blocks up to 3s waiting for process; run it off EDT? It uses destroyForcibly + waitFor 3s. Better to run in a background thread via ThreadMaster? Simpler: do it in a daemon Thread; execution listener will finish the panel. Actually the language's `run()` thread gets the process exit and calls handleExit → notifyExecutionFinished → finishExecution on EDT. So the Stop button just needs to call forceStop. To avoid blocking EDT up to 3s, wrap in a thread. Let's use `new Thread(...)` daemon? There's ThreadMaster with RunnableNode. Use RunnableNode + ThreadMaster.register for consistency (as used elsewhere).
> 
> Let me check IOPanelTest to see existing expectations (debug controls visible etc.) and then implement.
> 
> Also add tests: IOPanel tests for copy-ability (e.g., non-editable but focusable and copy action works) and for run stop button. And Go: a unit test for the launch-failure fast path in DapSession. Maybe a fake adapter test exists (DapSessionIntegrationTest). Let's look at tests for dap.
>

      package io.simpleide.ui.io;
      
      import java.awt.Color;
      
      import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
      import javax.swing.text.StyledDocument;
      
      import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
      
      import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
      
      import io.simpleide.language.AbstractLanguage;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.Input;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.Output;
      import io.simpleide.language.io.OutputType;
      
      /**
       * Tests {@link io.simpleide.ui.io.IOPanel}.
       */
      class IOPanelTest {
      
        @Test
        void coloursAndPrefixesEveryOutputType() throws Exception {
          IOPanel panel = new IOPanel();
      
          SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> {
            panel.appendLine(OutputType.OUTPUT, "hello");
            panel.appendLine(OutputType.ERROR, "broken");
            panel.appendLine(OutputType.DEBUG, "diagnostic");
          });
      
          String output = panel.getOutputText();
          assertThat(output).contains("[OUTPUT] hello").contains("[ERROR] broken").contains("[DEBUG] diagnostic");
      
          StyledDocument document = panel.getOutputPane().getStyledDocument();
          Color errorColor = (Color) document.getCharacterElement(output.indexOf("[ERROR]"))
            .getAttributes()
            .getAttribute(javax.swing.text.StyleConstants.Foreground);
          Color debugColor = (Color) document.getCharacterElement(output.indexOf("[DEBUG]"))
            .getAttributes()
            .getAttribute(javax.swing.text.StyleConstants.Foreground);
          assertThat(errorColor).isNotNull();
          assertThat(debugColor).isNotNull();
        }
      
        @Test
        void redirectsProgramOutputAndInputWhileRunning() throws Exception {
          IOPanel panel = new IOPanel();
          TestLanguage language = new TestLanguage();
          drainInput();
      
          panel.beginRun(language);
          assertThat(panel.isExecutionActive()).isTrue();
          assertThat(panel.isDebugMode()).isFalse();
      
          Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.OUTPUT, "program line");
          SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> {
          });
          assertThat(panel.getOutputText()).contains("[OUTPUT] program line");
      
          panel.setInputText("typed answer");
          assertThat(panel.submitInput()).isTrue();
          assertThat(Input.getInstance().get(1)).isEqualTo("typed answer");
      
          panel.finishExecution();
          assertThat(panel.isExecutionActive()).isFalse();
          String outputBeforeLaterEvent = panel.getOutputText();
          Output.getInstance().publish(OutputType.OUTPUT, "after program finished");
          SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> {
          });
          assertThat(panel.getOutputText()).isEqualTo(outputBeforeLaterEvent);
        }
      
        @Test
        void showsDebugControlsOnlyInDebugMode() {
          IOPanel panel = new IOPanel();
          assertThat(panel.getDebugControls().isVisible()).isFalse();
      
          panel.beginDebug(null);
          assertThat(panel.isDebugMode()).isTrue();
          assertThat(panel.getDebugControls().isVisible()).isTrue();
          assertThat(panel.getDebugControls().getComponentCount()).isEqualTo(6);
      
          panel.finishExecution();
          assertThat(panel.isDebugMode()).isFalse();
          assertThat(panel.getDebugControls().isVisible()).isFalse();
        }
      
        private static void drainInput() throws InterruptedException {
          while (Input.getInstance().get(0) != null) {
            // Drain lines left by other tests.
          }
        }
      
        private static final class TestLanguage extends AbstractLanguage {
      
        }
      
      }
